pṛ0 1) mātṛkābhedatantram
prathamaḥ paṭalaḥ
oṃ [namaḥ paradevatāyai gha |]namo devyai [kailāśa- gha ṅa |]kailāsaśikhare ramye nānāratnopaśobhite | papraccha parayā bhaktyā bhairavaṃ parameśvaram || 1 || śrīcaṇḍikovāca- tripurāpūjanaṃ nātha [sarva- gha ṅa]svarṇaratnairviśeṣataḥ[rvibhūṣaṇaiḥ kha-ga |]| kalikāle [svarṇaratnastaptabhāvastathā maṇiḥ kha-ga, sarvaratnaṃ ṅa |]svarṇarūpyaṃ guptabhāvaṃ tathā maṇim [ḥ] || 2 || kenopāyena deveśa svarṇarūpyādi[-ratnādi kha-ga-gha-ṅa |] labhyate | tad vadasva viśeṣeṇa yathā ratnādikaṃ bhavet || 3 || yannoktaṃ sarvvatantreṣu tad vadasva dayānidhe || 4 || śrīśaṅkara uvāca- śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi yathā ratnādikaṃ bhavet | mattejasā [pārakeṇa ṅa |]pāradena kiṃ ratnaṃ na hi labhyate || 5 || tathā sāmudrakeṇaiva suśubhralavaṇena[śuddhasāmudrake tathā kha-ga, śubhrasambalakena gha-ṅa |] ca | [sāmudrasya kha-ga |]sambalasya prakāraṃ hi [tacchṛṇuṣva priyaṃvade kha-ga |]śṛṇu devi prayatnataḥ || 6 || --------------------- 6 | sambalasyeti | dāramuc iti yasya prasiddhiriti ṅa-pustakaṭipyanyām |
pṛ0 2) cīnatantrānusāreṇa pūjayet [kālikāṃ parām kha-ga, siddhi- gha |]siddhakālikām | [ślokārddhamidaṃ nāsti kha-ga |]athavā pūjayed devīṃ dakṣiṇāṃ[dakṣiṇā-kā ka-kha-ga-gha |] kālikāṃ parām | kālītantroktavidhinā saptāhaṃ japapūjanam || 7 || satye caikantu tretāyāṃ dviguṇaṃ dvāpare trayam | evaṃ sarvvatra jānīyāccaturguṇajapaḥ kalau || 8 || ---------------------- 7 | kālītantreti | atra saṃkṣepataḥ kālītantroktā pūjā nirūpyate- athārccanavidhiṃ vakṣye devyāḥ sarvasamṛddhidam | yenānuṣṭhitamātreṇa svayaṃ bhairavarūpavān || ... ... ... ... ādau yantraṃ pravakṣyāmi yajjñātvā'maratāṃ vrajet || ādau trikoṇaṃ vinyasya trikoṇaṃ tadbahirnyaset | tato vai vilikhenmantrī trikoṇatrayamuttamam || vṛttaṃ vilikhya vidhivallikhet padmaṃ sulakṣaṇam | tato vṛttaṃ vilikhyaiva likhed bhūpuramekakam || caturasraṃ caturdvāramevaṃ maṇḍalamālikhet | pīṭhapūjāṃ tataḥ kṛtvā svavāme'rghyaṃ nyaset priye || mūlavidyāṃ ṣaḍaṅgena mūlamantreṇa cārccayet | tato hṛdayapadmāntaḥ sphurantīṃ paramāṃ kalām || yantramadhye samāvāhya nyāsajālaṃ pravinyaset | tato dhyātvā mahādevīmupacārān prakalpayet || namaskṛtya mahādevīṃ tata āvaraṇaṃ yajet | kālīṃ kapālinīṃ kullāṃ kurukullāṃ virodhinīm || vipracittāntu sampūjya bahiḥṣaṭkoṇake tataḥ | ugrāmugraprabhāṃ dīptāṃ tathā madhyatrikoṇake || nīlāṃ ghanāṃ balākāñca tathaivānyatrikoṇake | mātrāṃ mudrāṃ mitāñcaiva tathaivāntastrikoṇake || sarvāḥ śyāmā asikarā muṇḍamālāvibhūṣitāḥ | tarjanīṃ vāmahastena dhārayantyaḥ śucismitāḥ || tato vai mātaraḥ pūjyā brāhmī nārāyaṇī tathā | māheśvarī ca cāmuṇḍā kaumārī cāparājitā || vārāhī ca tathā pūjyā nārasiṃhī tathaiva ca || sarvāsāmapi devīnāṃ baliḥ pūjā tathaiva ca | anulepanakaṃ gandho dhūpadīpau tathaiva ca || tristriḥ pūjā prakarttavyā sarvāsāmapi sādhakaiḥ | gurupaṅktiṃ ṣaḍaṅgañca dikpālāṃśca tato'rccayet || evaṃ pūjāṃ purā kṛtvā mūlenaiva yathāvidhi | naivedyādīn yathāśaktyā dadyād devyai punaḥ punaḥ || tato vai daśa vārāṃstu dīpaṃ dadyāt tu sādhakaḥ | puṣpādikaṃ punardadyānmūlenaiva yathāvidhi || tataḥ sāvahito mantrī guruṃ natvā śiraḥsthitam | devīṃ dhyātvā cāṣṭottarasahasraṃ prajapen manum || tejomayaṃ japaphalaṃ devyā haste samarpayet | guhyātiguhyagoptrī tvamiti mantreṇa mantravit || tataḥ śirasi vai puṣpaṃ dattvāṣṭāṅgaṃ praṇamya ca | visṛjya parayā bhaktyā saṃhāreṇaiva bhaktitaḥ || udvāsya hṛdaye devīṃ tanmayo bhavati dhruvam | [saṃskṛta-sāhityapariṣat-prakāśita-kālītantram, 1 ma paḥ 25-58 | mantranyāsādikantu tatraiva prathamapaṭale'nusandheyam |]
pṛ0 3) ānīya bahuyatnena sambalaṃ tolakadvayam | vasurādyaṃ śivaṃ cādyaṃ[cādyāṃ ka|] māyābinduvibhūṣitam[tām ka-kha-ga |] | bījatrayaṃ cāṣṭaśataṃ prajapet[japeta gha |] sambalopari || 9 || aśītitolakaṃ mānaṃ [kṛṣṇā-dhe- ṅa |]kṛṣṇadhenusamudbhavam | dugdhamānīya yatnena cāṣṭottaraśataṃ[aṣṭottara- ka-kha-ga |] japet || 10 || vastrayuktena sūtreṇa dugdhamadhye vinikṣipet | uttāpaṃ janayeddhīmān mandamandena vahninā || 11 || bindu[vedāṅga kha-ga, vedāgni- gha, vedāhna- ṅa |]vedāntaparyantamarddhaśoṣaṃ[-marddhaśeṣaṃ kha-ga-gha |] bhaved yadā | tadaivauttolya[tadaivottulyate dravyaṃ gha |] taddravyaṃ toyamadhye[dugdhatoye gha |] vinikṣipet || 12 || tataḥ parīkṣā karttavyā pradadyāt pāvakopari | nirdhūmaṃ[nidhūmaṃ gha |] pāvake dravyaṃ dṛṣṭvā utthāpya yatnataḥ || 13 || tatraiva prajapenmantraṃ [sarvabandha- ka-kha-ga |]sarvvavandyanavātmakam[-mayātmakam kha-ga, sarvvabandhanarātmakam ṅa |] | [ka-ṅa-pustakayoridamarddhaṃ nāsti |]ānīya bahuyatnena śuddhaṃ tāmraṃ manoharam || 14 || sārddhena tolakaṃ tāmraṃ vahnimadhye vinikṣipet | yathā [vahniṃ tathā ka-ṅa |]vahnistathā tāmraṃ dṛṣṭvā utthāpya yatnataḥ || 15 || guñjāpramāṇaṃ [taṃ dravyaṃ ka |]taddravyaṃ tatkṣaṇād[-kṣaṇe ka |] yadi yojayet | satyaṃ satyaṃ hi girije raupyaṃ bhavati niścitam || 16 || ----------------- 9 | vasurādyamityādi | ka-pustaka-ṭippanyāṃ klīṃ hrīṃ klīṃ, ityevaṃ mantro dṛśyate | 11 | vastrayuktena raktavastrayuktena iti ṅa-pustakaṭippanyām | 12 | ka-pustakaṭippanyāṃ binduvedāntaśabdasya catvāriṃśadityartho dṛśyate |
pṛ0 4) [gha-pustake śrī nāsti |]śrīcaṇḍikovāca- [kāraṇamityādyārabhya śailaje ityantā ślokacatuṣṭayī kha-ga-pustakayornāsti |]kāraṇaṃ dugdharūpaṃ vā kena rūpeṇa śaṅkara | tatprakāraṃ mahādeva kṛpayā vada śaṅkara || 17 || śrīśaṅkara uvāca- ṭaṅkanam ānayeddhīmān tolakantu catuṣṭayam | vahniyogena girije [rājarūpaṃ ka-kha-ga-gha |]lājarūpañcakāraha || 18 || āmrapuṣpaṃ taddviguṇaṃ piṣṭvā milanamācaret | tasyopari japenmantraṃ mahāmāyāṃ hi caṇḍike || 19 || etat[tatra gha, tatastu ṅa |] tu guṭikāṃ kṛtvā [mīlanaṃ ṅa |]melanaṃ kārayed yadi | tadaiva dugdharūpaṃ syāt satyaṃ satyaṃ hi śailaje || 20 || śrīcaṇḍikovāca- gandhahīnaṃ bhavenmadyaṃ kenopāyena śaṅkara | tat sarvvaṃ śrotumicchāmi yadi sneho'sti māṃ prati || 21 || śrīśaṅkara uvāca- śivaṃ vahnisamārūḍhaṃ vāmanetravibhūṣitam | bindunādasamāyuktaṃ[-daṃ kalāyuktaṃ kha-ga, -da-kalāyuktaṃ gha-ṅa |] gandhamādāya saṃlikhet || 22 || uhyatāṃ[uṣṇatāṃ para- kha-ga, ūhyatām ka-kha-ga-gha |] padamuccāryya cāṣṭottaraśataṃ yadi | prajapet sādhakaśreṣṭho durgandhādivināśanam || 23 ||

śrīdevyuvāca- vada īśāna sarvvajña sarvvatattvavidāṃ vara | yat tvayā kathitaṃ [deva ṅa |]nātha mama saṅge vihārataḥ || 1 || kathaṃ vā jāyate putraḥ śukrasya[kathaṃ vā śukra- gha-prā |] kutra saṃsthitiḥ | varddhamānaṃ[varddhamānasya liṅgasya praveśo vā kathaṃ bhavet prā- |] sadā[mahāliṅgaṃ kha-ga |] liṅgaṃ praveśo[praveśaṃ ka-gha |] vā kathaṃ bhavet || 2 || bhītiyuktā hyahaṃ nātha trāhi māṃ [bhayasāgarāt kha-ga |]duḥkhasaṅkaṭāt || 3 || [gha-pustake śrīśaṅkara uvāca ityaṃśo nāsti, mahādeva uvāca prā |]śrīśaṅkara uvāca- maṇipūraṃ mahāpadmaṃ suṣumṇāmadhyasaṃsthitam | tasya[tasmānnālena gha-prā |] nālena deveśi nābhipadmaṃ manoharam || 4 || [raktatraya- kha-ga, vaktra ṅa, nālatraya- prā |]vakratrayasamāyuktaṃ sadā śukravibhūṣitam | ūrddhvaṃ[ūrddhanālaṃ kha-ga-gha |] nālaṃ sahasrāre ataḥ śukravibhūṣitam || 5 || tasmādeva stanadvandvaṃ varddhamānaṃ[varddhate ca kha-ga |] dine dine || 6 || madhyanālaṃ suṣumṇāntaṃ vṛntākāraṃ[vṛttākāraṃ kha-ga |] suśītalam | [āyonyanta- gha |]āyonyagra-madhonālaṃ[-nāle sadānandamayaṃ kha-ga, -mayaṃ ṅa-prā |] sadānandamayi śive[-nandamayī śive gha, śivam ṅa |] || 7 || śṛṇu cārvaṅgi subhage tanmadhye liṅgatāḍanāt[-tāḍanam kha-ga |] | yadrūpaṃ paramānandaṃ tannāsti bhuvanatraye || 8 ||
pṛ0 6) nābhipadmantu yadrūpaṃ tacchṛṇuṣva samāhitaḥ(tā)[-hitā prā |] | [bindu-nālaṃ kha-ga, va-[va] sthānaṃ madhyadeśe'sya prā |]bindusthānaṃ madhyadeśe sadā padmavirājitam || 9 || bāhyadeśe cāṣṭapatraṃ[cāṣṭaśataṃ kha-ga |] caturasraṃ tu[ca prā |] tadbahiḥ | caturdvārasamāyuktaṃ suvarṇābhaṃ savṛttakam[suvṛntakam kha-ga, savṛntakam ṅa-prā |] || 10 || tatpatreṇa[-padmena gha-ṅa-prā |] bhavet puṣpaṃ vṛntayuktaṃ tripatrakam | praphulle tu tripatrāre[tripatre vai prā |] bāhye[bāhya kha-ga |] [śoṇita- prā |]rudhiradarśanam || 11 || etanmadhye[tanmadhye ca kha-ga |] maheśāni yadi syālliṅgatāḍanam | padmamadhye gate śukre santatistena jāyate || 12 || ------------------- 12 | etanmadhya ityādi | tatrāpi kālādiniyamāha- śāktānandataraṅgiṇīprathamaparicchedadhṛtajñānabhāṣye- rajasvalā ca yā nārī viśuddhā pañcame dine | pīḍitā kāmabāṇena tataḥ puruṣamīhate || bhagaliṅgasamāyogānmaithunaṃ syāt tadā tayoḥ | anyo'nyasparśanādeva jāyate ca mahāsukham || kṣarate ca yadā retaḥ prāṇāpānavisaṃśritam | kṣitirāpastathā tejo vāyurākāśameva ca || sarveṣāṃ tatra tattvaṃ syād dehastharaktabījayoḥ || iti | padmamadhya ityādi | padmamadhye śukragamanaprakārastu prapañcasāre- svasthānaścyutācchukrād bindumādāya mārutaḥ | garbhāśayaṃ praviśati yadā tulyaṃ tadāparaḥ || ārttavāt paramaṃ bījamādāyāsyāśca mūlataḥ | yadā garbhāśayaṃ neṣyatyatha saṃmiśrayenmarut || saṃkṣobhya saṃvarddhayati tanmalaṃ śoṇitādhikam | strī syācchukrādhikaṃ nā syāt samena ca napuṃsakam || vāyuvahnyambhasāṃ yoge garbhavṛddhiḥ prajāyate | tathā jñānabhāṣye- nābhipadme mahādevi bhrāmyate ca samīraṇaiḥ | kumbhakāro yathā cakre ghaṭate ca ghaṭādikam || tathā samīraṇo garbhe ghaṭate prāṇināṃ tanum | vīryavadgarbhakāraṇamuktaṃ rāghavabhaṭṭadhṛtādhyātmaviveke- pūrvaṣoḍaśavarṣā strī pūrṇaviṃśena saṅgatā | śuddhagarbhāśaye mārge rakte śukre'nile hṛdi || vīryavantaṃ sutaṃ sūte tato nyūnābdayoḥ punaḥ | rogālpāyuradhanyo vā garbho bhavati naiva vā || iti |
pṛ0 7) puruṣasya tu yacchukraṃ śakte[śaktirvvā cādhikā gha, śukraṃ vā cādhikaṃ kha-ga, sakteratrā- ṅa, śaktestasyādhikaṃ yadi prā |]raktādhiko bhavet | tadā kanyā[kanyāṃ vijānīyād prā |] bhaveddevi viparītaḥ[viparītāt kha-ga, viparīte gha-ṅa prā |] pumān bhavet || 13 || ubhayostulyaśukreṇa klīvaṃ bhavati niścitam || 14 || śṛṇu cārvvaṅgi subhage puṣpamāhātmyamuttamam | madhye[medhyaṃ prā |] tacchukrasaṃyoge[-yogena kha-ga |] varddhate tad[ca gha-prā |] dine dine | evaṃ diṅmāsasaṃprāpte[saṃprāptau prā |] tat[tatpuṣpe vṛntasaṃyute gha-prā, tatpuṣpaṃ vṛttasaṃyute ṅa |] puṣpaṃ vṛntasaṃyutam || 15 || galite[gaṇite kha-ga |] parameśāni vyakto[vyaktā prā |] bhavati santatiḥ || 16 || śrīdevyuvāca[śrī nāsti ka-kha, śrīśiva uvāca kha-ga?]- kiñcidrogādisambhūte kṛmikīṭādisambhave | tasmājjīvaṃ[tasyā jīvaṃ kha-ga, -jjīve gha, tasyā jīvaḥ ṅa, -jjīvāḥ prā, |] praṇaśyanti sā[ninarī ? gha |] nārī jīvyate[jīvate prā |] katham || 17 || śrīśaṅkara uvāca[ka-kha-ga-pustakeṣu śrī nāsti |]- asya[tasya kha-ga-gha-ṅa-prā |] puṣpasya māhātmyaṃ kiṃ vaktuṃ śakyate mayā | bindusthānaṃ[bindusthāna-sa- gha-prā |] sahasrantu puṣpamadhye priyaṃvade || 18 || -------------------- 13 | puruṣasyetyādi | śāradātilake'pyuktam- raktādhikā bhavennārī bhavedreto'dhikaḥ pumān | ubhayoḥ samatāyāntu napuṃsakamiti sthitiḥ || 14 | ubhayorityādi | tatrādhikatulyatādikaṃ pramāṇīkṛtaṃ rāghavabhaṭṭena- dvāviṃśatī rajobhāgāḥ śukramātrāścaturddaśa | garbhasañjanane kāle puṃstriyoḥ sambhavanti hi || nārī rajo'dhikāṃśe syānnaraḥ śukrādhikāṃśake | ubhayoruktasaṅkhyāyāṃ syānnapuṃsakasambhavaḥ || iti |
pṛ0 8) budbudā yatra[ye'tra prā |] tiṣṭhanti tatraiva santatirbhavet | evaṃ krameṇa deveśi sahasraṃ santatiryadi[-ryadā kha-ga |] | varddhamānaṃ [tadā prā |]mahāpuṣpaṃ pīḍā kiñcinna jāyate || 19 || [mama ka-gha-ṅa |]mayā sārddhaṃ maheśāni vihāraṃ kuru yatnataḥ | vihāre yo bhavet putro gaṇeśaḥ [saiva ṅa |]sa ca kīrttitaḥ || 20 || apare parameśāni tava putraprasādataḥ | pṛthivyāṃ jāyate sṛṣṭirnnirvvighnena yathocitam || 21 || [ka-kha-ga-gha-pustakeṣu idamarddhaṃ nāsti |]etac śrutvā tato devī madanānalavihvalā | śivenāliṅgitā devī śivākāreṇa vai tadā || 22 ||

pṛ0 9) tṛtīyaḥ paṭalaḥ |
śrīdevyuvāca- sarvvatrāhaṃ[sarvatraiva śrutaṃ kha-ga |] śrutā nātha bhogaṃ [ca śriya- ? gha |]cendriyapuṣṭidam | bhogena mokṣamāpnoti kathaṃ vadasi yogabhṛt || 1 || śrīśaṅkara uvāca- bhogena labhate yogaṃ bhogena kulasādhanam | bhogena siddhimāpnoti bhogena mokṣamāpnuyāt || 2 || tasmād bhogaṃ sadā kāryyaṃ bāhyapūjā yathecchayā[yadecchayā ka |] | bhojanasya vidhānaṃ[yadvidhānaṃ ka |] yat tacchṛṇuṣva priyaṃvade || 3 || mūlādhāre tu yā śaktirbhujagākārarūpiṇī | jīvātmā parameśāni tanmadhye varttate sadā || 4 || bhojanecchā[bhojaneṣu bhavet tasya ni- kha-ga, bhojanecchā bhavettasyā ni- gha |] bhavet tasmānnirllipto jīvasaṃjñakaḥ | saiva sākṣād guṇamayī nirguṇo jīva ucyate || 5 || jīvasya bhojanaṃ devi bhrāntireva[bhrāntiḥ kevalasaṃśayaḥ ka-kha-ga |] na saṃśayaḥ | guṇayuktā kuṇḍalinī candrasūryāgnirūpiṇī || 6 || mūlādhārācca tāṃ[-dhārasthitāṃ ka |] devīmājihvāntāṃ[-hvāṃ tāṃ ka, -hvāntaṃ gha-ṅa |] vibhāvayet | śodhitān matsyamāṃsādīn sammukhe sthāpayed budhaḥ || 7 || ------------------- 7| śodhitānityādi | matsyamāṃsādiśodhanamāha mahānirvāṇatantre pañcamollāse- māṃsamānīya puratastrikoṇamaṇḍalopari | phaṭābhyukṣya vāyuvahnibījābhyāṃ mantrayet tridhā || kavacenāvaguṇṭhyātha saṃrakṣeccāstramantrataḥ | dhenvā vamamṛtīkṛtya mantrametadudīrayet ||
pṛ0 10) mūlamantraṃ samuccāryya juhomi kuṇḍalīmukhe | anena manunā devi [sarva grāsaṃ gha-ṅa |]pratigrāsaṃ [samuddharet ka-kha-ga |]samāharet || 8 || pratigrāse [maheśāni ṅa |]pareśāni evaṃ kuryyādvicakṣaṇaḥ | tadaiva brahmarūpo'sau satyaṃ satyaṃ sureśvari || 9 || [pūjyate ka |]bhujyate kuṇḍalī devī iti cintāparo hi[bhavet gha |] yaḥ | mantrasiddhirbhavettasya jñānasiddhirna cānyathā || 10 || evaṃ kṛte brahmarūpaḥ śivarūpaḥ svayaṃ hariḥ | yogasiddhirbhavettasya cāṣṭasiddhirbhaviṣyati || 11 || śatrubhirdīyate yat[yasmai kha-ga, devi gha |] tu kṛtrimaṃ dāruṇaṃ viṣam | bhakṣaṇāt tatkṣaṇe[tatkṣaṇāt kha-ga |] devi hyamṛtaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ || 12 || mantreṇa [puṭitaṃ gha |]śodhitaṃ dravyaṃ bhakṣaṇādamṛtaṃ bhavet | yadaiva[tadeva kha-ga, yadaika- gha |] kālakūṭantu[-ṭaṃ hi kha-ga |] samudramathane priye || 13 || tadā cānena[cāreṇa ka-kha-ga-ṅa |] manunā[madhunā ka |] tatkṣaṇāt khāditaṃ mayā || 14 || sarpākārā kuṇḍalinī yā devī paramā kalā | bhujyate sarparūpeṇa tatraiva[tattatraivorage gha |] dāruṇaṃ viṣam || 15 || iti te kathitaṃ kānte bhojanasya vidhānakam | etat sarvvaṃ maheśāni goptavyaṃ paśusaṅkaṭe || 16 || ------------------ viṣṇorvvakṣasi yā devī yā devī śaṅkarasya ca | māṃsaṃ me pavitrīkuru kuru tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam || itthaṃ mīnaṃ samānīya proktamantreṇa saṃskṛtam | mantreṇānena matimāṃstaṃ mīnamabhimantrayet || oṃ tryaṃbakaṃ yajāmahe sugandhiṃ puṣṭivardhanam | urvārukamiva bandhanānmṛtyormukṣīya māmṛtāt || athavā sarvvatattvāni mūlenaiva viśodhayet | kevalaṃ mūlamantreṇa yaddravyaṃ śodhitaṃ bhavet || tadeva devatāprītyai supraśastaṃ mayocyate || iti | [mahānirvvāṇatantram, pañcamollāsaḥ, 206-210, 231-234]
pṛ0 11) śrīdevyuvāca- śṛṇu nātha parānanda[...nandaṃ gha |] parāparakulātmaka[parameśa kulāntaka kha-ga, -kulāntakam gha, kulātmakam ṅa |] | vada me parameśāna homakuṇḍantu kīdṛśam || 17 || śrīśiva uvāca- maṇipūrasya bāhye tu nābhipadmaṃ manoharam | aṣṭapatraṃ tathā vṛttaṃ tanmadhye kuṇḍadurlabham || 18 || [-caturvvarṇā- ka, -caturhastā- kha-ga |]caturasrādikaṃ devi tat kuṇḍaṃ kāmarūpakam | sarvvakuṇḍasya deveśi vipraḥ[viprakarttā ka |] karttā vidhīyate || 19 || varttulaṃ bāhujātasya vaiśyasya [arddha- kha-ga |]cārddhacandrakam || 20 || trikoṇaṃ pādajātasya homakuṇḍaṃ sureśvari | evaṃ kuṇḍaṃ maheśāni nālatrayavibhūṣitam || 21 || ūrddhvanālaṃ sahasrāre[sahasrārāmṛtabinduvibhūṣitam kha-ga |] [paramāmṛtavibhūṣitam ka |]parāmṛtavibhūṣitam | [madhye nālaṃ kha-ga |]madhyanālaṃ [-nābhimadhye kha-ga |]nābhipadme mūlādhāre ca sundari || 22 || āliṅgāgramadhonālaṃ sadānandamayaṃ śive | homakuṇḍamidaṃ devi sarvvatantre[-tantrapari- kha-ga-gha |] pariṣkṛtam || 23 || yena homaprasādena sākṣādbrahmamayo bhavet | viprasya [cāhutīṃ homo ka, cāhutiṃ home gha |]cāhutirhomaṃ vijñātavyaṃ catuṣṭayam || 24 || ------------------ 19 | caturasra ityādi | atra saṃvādi pramāṇamuktaṃ tantrāntaratantre'pi- viprāṇāṃ caturasraṃ syād rājñāṃ varttulamiṣyate | vaiśyānāmarddhacandrābhaṃ śūdrāṇāṃ tryasramīritam || iti |
pṛ0 12) kṣatriyasya[bāhujātasya ka, rājanyasya gha-ṅa |] trayaṃ devi vaiśyasya cāhutidvayam | [pādajātasya home tu dadyādekāhutiṃ śive | caturvarṇasya homeṣu kha-ga |]śūdrasyaikāhutirdevi[-hutiṃ devi gha-ṅa |] [muktiñcāpi caturvidhām gha-ṅa |]muktiścāpi caturvidhā || 25 || mahāmokṣaṃ brāhmaṇasya sāyujyaṃ kṣatriyasya ca | sārūpyañcorujātasya sālokyaṃ [pāda- ka-gha-ṅa |]śūdrajātiṣu || 26 || bāhyakuṇḍaṃ[bāhyaṃ kuṇḍaṃ kha-ga-gha |] bāhyahome[-homo ka |] evaṃ hi suravandite | jātibhede[-bhedaṃ ka |] kuṇḍabhedaṃ kuryyāt sādhakasattamaḥ || 27 || bāhyahome[asya ślokasya sthāne kha-ga-pustakayoḥ sannyāsamagnihomañca tāvadeva kalau yuge ayaṃ pāṭhaḥ- |] [kāryya- gha-ṅa |]kāmyasiddhirbhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ | jñānahome mokṣasiddhirlabhate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 28 || iti te kathitaṃ kānta tantrāṇāṃ sāramuttamam | na vaktavyaṃ paśoragre śapatho[saṃśayo kha-ga |] me tvayi priye || 29 || śrīdevyuvāca- madyapāne[-dāne kha-ga |] mahāpuṇyaṃ sarvvatantre śrutaṃ mayā | jātibhedaṃ[-bhede gha-ṅa |] na kathitamidānīṃ tat prakāśaya || 30 || [mahādeva kha-ga |]śrīśaṅkara uvāca- sarvvayajñādhipo vipraḥ saṃśayo nāsti pārvvati | [śotrāmiṇyāṃ ṅa, saṃyāminyāṃ kulācāre ṅa pustaka-ṭippanīpāṭhaḥ |]sautrāmaṇyāṃ kulācāre[mahe yajñe kha-ga, mahāyajñe gha-ṅa-prā |] catvāro[tattvajñā kha-ga |] brāhmaṇādayaḥ || 31 || -------------- 26 | mahāmokṣamityādi | atra saṃvādi pramāṇantu nirvāṇatantre dvitīyapaṭale- brāhmaṇasya mahāmokṣaṃ sāyujyaṃ kṣatriyasya ca | sārūpyañcorujātasya śūdrasya sahalokatām || iti |
pṛ0 13) brāhmaṇasya mahāmokṣaṃ madyapāne[-dāne ka |] priyaṃvade | brāhmaṇaḥ parameśāni yadi pānādikañcaret || 32 || tatkṣaṇā[tatkṣaṇe śiva- ka-gha-ṅa |]-cchivarūpau'sau satyaṃ satyaṃ hi śailaje || 33 || toye[toyaṃ toye gha |] toyaṃ yathā līnaṃ yathā[tejasi tejasaṃ tathā kha-ga, tejasaṃ tejasi yathā ka, tejasaṃ taijase yathā prā |] tejasi tejasam | ghaṭe bhagne[bhagnaṃ kha-ga-prā |] yathā''kāśaṃ vāyau [vāyuṃ yathā bhavet gha-ṅa |]vāyuryathā priye || 34 || tathaiva madyapānena brāhmaṇo brahmaṇi[brāhmaṇi ka] priye | līyate nā'tra sandehaḥ paramātmani śailaje || 35 || sāyujyādi mahāmokṣaṃ niyuktaṃ kṣatriyādiṣu | sā[sā nārī madyapānena tattaddevī ka-ṅa |] nārī mānavī [uktvā devi kha-ga |]madyapāne devī na saṃśayaḥ || 36 || sūkṣmasūtre yathā vahnirdehamadhye tathā[yathā śivaḥ kha-ga |] śivā | [tato rūpaṃ ka |]taporūpaṃ bṛhat sūtraṃ pūjārūpaṃ tathā hariḥ[haviḥ gha |] || 37 || saṃyuktaṃ kurute[kārayedatra kha-ga |] yatra varddhamāno[-na- uṣarbudhaḥ ka-ṅa |] mahāṅkuśaḥ | madyapānaṃ vinā devi tajjñānaṃ[tattvajñānaṃ na labhyate kha-ga-prā |] na hi labhyate | ata eva hi vipreṇa[viprastu prā |] madyapānaṃ sadā[samā- prā |] caret || 38 || ----------------- 32 | brāhmaṇasyetyādi | atra saṃvādi pramāṇamuktaṃ guptasādhanatantre saptamapaṭale- yadi vipro bhaveddevi pañcatattvaparāyaṇaḥ | satyaṃ satyaṃ maheśāni paratattve pralīyate || yathā jalaṃ toyamadhye līyate parameśvari | tathaiva tattvasevāyāṃ līyate paramātmani || kṣatriyaḥ parameśāni sahayoge vased dhruvam | vaiśyastu labhate devi svarūpaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ || śūdrastu parameśāni sahaloke sadā vaset | etadanyo maheśāni yadi tattvaparāyaṇaḥ || satyaṃ satyaṃ maheśāni muktiphalamakhaṇḍitam | senānīḥ parameśāni devīdehe pralīyate || śodhanañca mayā proktaṃ nīlatantrādiyāmale | na kasmaicit pravaktavyaṃ prakāśācchivahā bhavet || iti |

pṛ0 15) havirāropamātreṇa vahnirdīpto yathā bhavet | śāpamocanamātreṇa surā muktipradāyinī || 42 || ata eva hi deveśi brāhmaṇaḥ pānamācaret | sa brāhmaṇaḥ sa vedajñaḥ so'gnihotrī sa dīkṣitaḥ || 43 || bahu kiṃ kathyate devi sa eva [nirguṇātmakaḥ prā |]triguṇātmakaḥ || 44 || muktimārgamidaṃ devi goptavyaṃ paśusaṅkaṭe[-sannidhau gha |] | prakāśāt kāryyahāniḥ syān nindanīyo na cānyathā || 45 ||

pṛ0 16) caturthaḥ paṭalaḥ |
[śrī nāsti ka |]śrīcaṇḍikovāca- kāraṇena mahāmokṣaṃ[mokṣo prā |] nirmmālyena śivasya ca | śrutaṃ vede[deva kha-ga, veda- prā |] purāṇe ca[-ṇeṣu kha-ga-prā |] tava vaktre[bhaktaḥ sureśvaraḥ kha-ga, vaktrāt gha, vākye maheśvaraḥ prā |] sureśvara || 1 || agrāhyaṃ tava nirmmālyamagrāhyaṃ kāraṇaṃ vibho | mṛṣā vākyaṃ mahādeva kathaṃ vadasi yogabhṛt || 2 || -------------------- 1 | nirmmālyenetyādi | atra saṃvādi pramāṇam- śivadattaṃ viṣṇudattaṃ girijādattameva ca | naivedyamudare kṛtvā naraḥ sāyujyamāpnuyāt || iti | tathā- rogaṃ harati nirmmālyaṃ śokantu caraṇodakam | naivedyaṃ sarvapāpāni śambhordahati niścitam || iti haratattvadīdhitidhṛtatantrakaumudīvacanadvayam | 2 | agrāhyamityādi | śivanirmmālyasyāgrāhyatoktā kālikāpurāṇe- agrāhyaṃ śivanirmālyaṃ patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ jalamiti | padmapurāṇe ca- dravyamannaṃ phalaṃ toyaṃ śivasya na spṛśet kvacit | na nayecchivanirmālyaṃ kūpe sarvaṃ vinikṣipet || makṣikāpādamātraṃ yaḥ śivasvamupajīvati | lobhānmohāt patatyeva kalpāntaṃ narake naraḥ || iti | purāṇasaṃgrahe'pi- śiva uvāca | anarhaṃ mama naivedyaṃ patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ jalam | śālagrāmaśilālagnaṃ sarvaṃ yāti pavitratām || naivedyañca naro bhuktvā śuddhyaiva cāndrāyaṇañcarediti etadeva devyāḥ praśne bījam | atra devyāḥ praśne bījarūpeṇa vacanānyucyante- tathā ca rudrayāmale- vedatyāgānmadyapānāc śūdradāraniṣevaṇāt | tatkṣaṇājjāyate vipraścaṇḍālādapi garhitaḥ || iti | kālīkulārṇave- surā vai malamannānāṃ purīṣaṃ malamucyate | tasmād brāhmaṇarājanyau vaiśyaśca na surāṃ pibet || surādarśanamātreṇa kuryyāt sūryyāvalokanam | tatsamāghrāṇamātreṇa prāṇāyāmatrayañcarediti || kubjikātantre ca- bhuktvā matsyañca māṃsañca spṛṣṭvā hetuñca bhairavi | trirātropoṣito bhūtvā pañcagavyena śudhyyatīti || kālīkulāmṛte caturthapaṭale ca- brāhmaṇastu surāṃ dattvā brāhmaṇyādeva hīyate | brāhmaṇaḥ paśurākhyātaḥ
pṛ0 17) śrīśaṅkara uvāca- śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi [nirmmālyaṃ paripṛcchati kha-ga, yanmā tvaṃ gha |]yanmāṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi | [etat kha-ga |]tattat sarvvaṃ pravakṣyāmi sāvadhānāvadhāsya || 3 || caturaśītilakṣeṣu [sahasreṣu ka-gha-ṅa |]yonigartte tathaiva hi | bhramaṇaṃ kurute jīvastato mokṣasya bhājanam || 4 || etanmadhye mahājñānaṃ yadi syād [sura- prā |]vīravandite | [tadaiva mokṣamāpnoti prā |]tadā mokṣamavāpnoti bhramaṇaṃ [kasya ka-gha-ṅa |]kena vā bhavet || 5 || [ayaṃ ślokaḥ ka-kha-ga-ṅa-pustakeṣu nāsti |]ata eva maheśāni guptabhāvamathākṛtam | yasya janma na [pūrṇantu prā |]pūrṇatvaṃ sa kathaṃ mokṣabhājanam | yasya [pāpādhikatvañca prā |]pāpādhikaṃ devi sa kathaṃ svargabhājanam || 6 || ['ata eva' ityārabhya 'surayā bhave'dityantoṃ'śaḥ kha-ga-pustakayornāsti |]ata eva [mahādevi prā |]maheśāni guptabhāvaṃ mayā kṛtam | nirmmālyena [labhet prā |]bhavet svargaṃ nirvvāṇaṃ surayā bhavet || 7 || pāpayukto hi cāṇḍālo nirmmālyaṃ gṛhyate yadā | tadā [mokṣo bhavet satyaṃ śivarūpo kha-ga-gha, mokṣaṃ bhavet satyaṃ śivarūpo ṅa, mokṣaṃ labhet satyaṃ śivarūpo prā |]mokṣamavāpnoti śivarūpī na cānyathā || 8 || ----------------- pāśavaṃ kalpamācaret || iti | vārāhītantre navamapaṭale ca- madyaṃ māṃsaṃ tathā matsyaṃ maithunaṃ parameśvari | mānuṣeṇa baliṃ pañca brāhmaṇo na smaret kvacit || iti | śrīkrame ca- na dadyād brāhmaṇo madyaṃ mahādevyai kathañcana | vāmakāmo brāhmaṇo'pi madyaṃ māṃsaṃ na bhakṣayet || iti | kulacūḍāmaṇau ca- yatrāsavamavaśyantu brāhmaṇastu viśeṣataḥ | guḍārdrakaṃ tadā dadyāt tāmre vā visṛjenmadhu || iti merutantre prathamapaṭale- vāmamārgeṇa taccādyavarṇaṃ hitvā praśasyate | brāhmaṇastu surāṃ pītvā rauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajet | vāmamārgī brāhmaṇo'pi madyaṃ māṃsaṃ na bhakṣayet || iti |
pṛ0 18) mahāpātakayukto'pi[-yukto vā kāraṇaṃ pīyate yadā ka-ṅa, -yukto'pi kāraṇaṃ pīyate yadā- gha |] kāraṇaṃ prapibed yadi | [tadā mukti- kha-ga-prā |]jñānānmuktirbhavet satyaṃ jātibhedādikaṃ na hi || 9 || sarvvajātiṣu nirvvāṇaṃ jñānena parameśvari | ata eva [hi deveśi kha-ga |]maheśāni guptabhāvaṃ mayā kṛtam || 10 || guptabhāvārtha[-bhāvārtha kha-ga |]-yadvākyaṃ [parihārārtha- gha |]parihāsārthameva ca[hi kha-ga |] | [tattadarthena gha-ṅa, tattadarthena madvākyaṃ kha-ga |]tadarthameva tad vākyaṃ na mithyā parameśvari || 11 || nirvāṇaviṣaye devi madyaṃ paramakāraṇam | madyapānaṃ vinā devi [mahāmokṣaṃ ka-kha-ga-ṅa |]mahāmokṣo na labhyate || 12 || śrīcaṇḍikovāca- gaṅgāyāṃ jñānato mokṣaṃ tathaiva mriyate yadi | gaṅgāyāścādhikaṃ nātha kāraṇaṃ [deva- kha-ga, parama- ṅa |]paradurlabham || 13 || śrīśaṅkara uvāca- pūrṇabrahmamayī [devī ka-gha |]devi [sudhā- gha-ṅa |]surādevī na cānyathā | tasyāśca ṣoḍaśāṃśaikā yā gaṅgā [bhuvidurlabhā ka-ṭippanī |]surapūjitā || 14 || tathaiva tulasī devī śatāṃśaikā [na saṃśayaḥ kha-ga |]sureśvarī | [vimūḍho hi kha-ga |]vimokṣārthī ca yo marttyastīrthasevāṃ na cācaret || 15 || [tathaiva ṅa |]yathaiva mālikāmadhye mahāśaṅkhaṃ vimokṣadam | tathaiva kāraṇaṃ devi [mahāmokṣa- kha-ga |]sadā mokṣapradāyakam || 16 || ----------------- 16 | mahāśaṅkhamityādi | mahāśaṅkhamālāyā vaiśiṣṭyaṃ tatkāraṇasyāsthnaḥ pañcāśadvarṇabījātmakatvakathanenāha prāṇatoṣaṇīdhṛtanityātantre dvitīyapaṭale- bhaga-
pṛ0 19) kāraṇena vinā devi mokṣajñānādikaṃ na hi | mahāśaṅkhaṃ vinā devi na mantraḥ siddhidāyakaḥ || 17 || sākṣād brahmamayī mālā mahāśaṅkhākhyayā[-khyameva ca ṅa |] punaḥ | śilāyantre[-yantreṣu kha-ga, -mantre ca gha |] ca vṛndāyāṃ gaṅgāyāṃ surapūjite[-pūjitām gha |] | [naivaṃ spṛśa- kha-ga |]naiva spṛśenmahāśaṅkhaṃ sparśanāt kāṣṭhavad bhavet || 18 || ----------------------- rūpā mahāmāyā śukra-tarpaṇatatparā | jagadākaṣiṇī vidyā jagadguhyā varānane || tatraiva gṛhyate sāraṃ jagatāṃ bījarūpakam | tadbījaṃ parameśāni pañcāśadvarṇarūpakam || garbhaṃ prāpya bhavedasthi śiśormajjāsamanvitam | tadasthi tvarddhamapyasti pañcāśadvarṇarūpakam | mahāśaṅkhasvarūpamāha tārākalpe- nṛlalāṭāsthikhaṇḍena racitā japamālikā | mahāśaṅkhamayī mālā | iti | karṇanetrāntarasthāsthimahāśaṅkhaḥ prakīrttitaḥ | iti ca | bṛhannīlatantre caturthapaṭale'pi- yuddhe mṛtasya deveśi caṇḍālasyāsthikena ca | mastakasya viśeṣeṇa mahāśaṅkhaḥ prakīrttitaḥ || iti | muṇḍamālātantre dvitīyapaṭale'pi- narāṅgulyasthibhirmālā grathitā parvabhedataḥ | sarvasiddhipradā mokṣadāyinī varavarṇini || nāḍyā saṃgrathitā mālā kāryā raktena vāsasā | nāḍībhirgrathitā mālā mahāsiddhipradā priye || iti | mahāśaṅkhaviśeṣasya varjanīyatvamāha nityātantre- svecchāmṛtaṃ striyaṃ vipraṃ tiryyagayonigataṃ tathā | rogiṇaṃ yavanaṃ vṛddhaṃ dīkṣitañcāpi varjayet || grāhyatvamapyāha tatraiva- vajrāhataṃ sarpadaṣṭaṃ patitvā vā jale mṛtam | vyāghrādinihataṃ vāpi sammukhe vā raṇe mṛtam || caṇḍālādyāḥ pradhānāste adhamāḥ śūdrajātayaḥ | iti | 18 | śilāyantra ityādi | uktametat svatantratantre'pi- ānīya cchinnaśīrṣasya narasya patitasya ca | tulasīgomayāspṛṣṭaṃ tathā gaṅgodakena ca || yavanabrāhmaṇāsyasya tatkāryyaṃ sādhakairjanaiḥ | aspṛśyaṃ tacca jānīyācchālagrāmaśilādibhiḥ || iti |
pṛ0 20) [śrīpārvvatyuvāca kha-ga |]śrīcaṇḍikovāca- gaṅgā [kāraṇavāri ca gha, gaṅgā kāraṇavācī ca ka |]tu kāraṇaṃ vāri madyaṃ paramakāraṇam | kāraṇasparśamātreṇa [mālā ityārabhya deveśa ityantoṃ'śaḥ kha-ga-pustakayornāsti, mālāstuṣṭā gha, mālā tuṣṭā ṅa |]mālāḥ śuddhā bhavanti hi || 19 || [gaṅgāyāḥ sparśamātreṇa ṅa |]gaṅgāsparśena deveśa kāṣṭhavanmālikā katham | vada me parameśāna iti me saṃśayo hṛdi || 20 || śrīśaṅkara uvāca- kāraṇaṃ devadeveśi mokṣadaṃ sarvvajātiṣu | tathā svargādijanakaṃ gaṅgātoyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 21 || kāraṇe nivased devi mahākālī parā kalā | [ayaṃ ślokaḥ kha-ga-pustakayornāsti |]mahāvidyā vasennityaṃ [surayā gha |]surāyāṃ parameśvari || 22 || mahāśaṅkhe vasennityaṃ pañcāśadvarṇarūpiṇī | mahāvidyā vasennityaṃ mahāśaṅkhe ca sarvvadā || 23 || gaṅgāsparśanamātreṇa gaṅgāyāṃ līyate [dhruvam kha-ga |]priye | ['kāṣṭhe'tyādi 'priye' ityantoṃ'śaḥ kha-ga-pustakayornāsti |]kāṣṭhasparśanamātreṇa kāṣṭhe vahnistṛṇe[-stṛṇā ka, -stṛṇaṃ ṅa |] yathā || 24 || gaṅgāsparśe tathā devi gaṅgāyāṃ līyate priye | tatkṣaṇe ca [mahāśaṅkhaṃ ka-gha-ṅa |]mahāśaṅkhaḥ kāṣṭhavannātra saṃśayaḥ || 25 || śilāyantre tulasyādau tathaiva parameśvari || 26 || [mahāśaṅkhe ca kha-ga |]mahāśaṅkhākhyamālāyāṃ yo japet sādhakottamaḥ | aṣṭasiddhiḥ kare tasya sa eva śambhuravyayaḥ | maulau gaṅgā sthitā yasya gaṅgāsnānena tasya kim || 27 ||
pṛ0 21) vārāṇasī kāmarūpaṃ haridvāraṃ prayāgakam | gaṇḍakīṃ vadarikāṃ devi gaṅgāsāgarasaṅgamam || 28 || yasya bhaktirmahāśaṅkhe tasya darśanamātrataḥ | tīrthasnānaphalaṃ sarvvaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 29 || iti te kathitaṃ [sarvvaṃ gha |]kānte [sāraṃ gha, sārāt sāraṃ sudurlabham kha-ga |]sarvvaṃ paramadurlabham | [paśoragre na vaktavyaṃ ṅa |]na vaktavyaṃ paśoragre prāṇānte[-nte'pi kadācana kha-ga |] parameśvari[etadanantaraṃ iti te kathitaṃ devi rahasyaṃ sarvvakāmadam ityadhikaḥ pāṭhaḥ gha-ṅa-pustakayoḥ |] || 30 ||

pṛ0 22) pañcamaḥ paṭalaḥ |
śrīcaṇḍikovāca- pāradaṃ bhasmanirmāṇaṃ kenopāyena śaṅkara | tadahaṃ śrotumicchāmi [tad vadasva kṛpānidhe kha-ga |]yadi te'sti kṛpā mayi || 1 || śrīśaṅkara uvāca- pārade bhasmanirmāṇe nānāvighnāni[-vighnādi- kha-ga |] pārvvati | ata eva hi tatrādau śāntiṃ kuryyād dvijottamaḥ || 2 || varayet karmmakarttāraṃ vakṣyamāṇavidhānataḥ | pūjayet ṣoḍaśaṃ liṅgaṃ pārthivaṃ parvatātmaje || 3 || ṣoḍaśenopacāreṇa toḍaloktavidhānataḥ | bhogayogyaṃ pradātavyaṃ madhuparkaṃ sureśvari || 4 || pañcāmṛtena deveśaṃ snāpayecchuddhavāriṇā | puruṣasya [pramāṇañca kha-ga |]yathāyogyaṃ yugmavastraṃ nivedayet || 5 || [caturaṅgula- kha-ga |]caturaṅgulivistāraṃ raupyanirmmāṇapīṭhakam | alaṅkāraṃ yathāyogyaṃ [puruṣāya kha-ga |]puruṣasya nivedayet || 6 || --------------- 4 | ṣoḍaśenetyādi | ṣoḍaśopacārā uktāḥ śivārccanacandrikāyām- āsanaṃ svāgataṃ pādyamarghyamācamanīyakam | madhuparkācamasnānavasanābharaṇāni ca || gandhapuṣpe dhūpadīpau naivedyaṃ vandanaṃ tathā | prayojayedarccanāyāmupacārāṃstu ṣoḍaśa || iti | prakārāntaraṃ yathā kṛṣṇārccanacandrikādhṛta-mantraratnāvalyām- pādyārghyācamanīyañca snānaṃ vasanabhūṣaṇe | gandhapuṣpe dhūpadīpau naivedyācamanaṃ tataḥ || tāmbūlamarcanā stotraṃ tarpaṇañca namaskriyām | prayojayedarcanāyāmupacārāṃstu ṣoḍaśa || iti | toḍalatantroktaśivapūjā tu nirūpayiṣyate saptamapaṭale |
pṛ0 23) [alaktasaṃyutaṃ ka-kha-ga, alaktaṃ saṃyutaṃ vāri ṅa |]alaktakayutaṃ vāpi dadyānmalayajaṃ śive | ṣaḍaṅgadhūpaṃ deveśi pradadyācca punaḥ punaḥ || 7 || ghṛtayuktaṃ tathā dīpaṃ dadyāt kalyāṇahetave | naivedyaṃ vividhaṃ ramyaṃ nānāphalasamanvitam || 8 || [śarkarānnayutaṃ ka |]śarkarāsaṃyutaṃ kṛtvā pāyasaṃ vinivedayet | dadyāt toyaṃ maheśāni vijayāsaṃyutaṃ priye || 9 || ṣaḍakṣaraṃ mahāmantraṃ [japedeka- kha-ga |]gajāntakasahasrakam | prajapet sādhakaśreṣṭhastataḥ siddho bhaved dhruvam || 10 || athavā parameśāni dhanadāṃ dhanadāyinīm | pūjayed bahuyatnena ṣoḍaśenopacārataḥ || 11 || ---------------- 7 | ṣaḍaṅga ityādi | ṣaḍaṅgadhūpo yathā śāradāyām- guggulu agurūśīraśarkarāmadhucandanaiḥ | dhūpayedājyasaṃmiśrairnīcairdevasya deśikaḥ || 4rthaḥ paḥ 106-107 | prakārāntaramapi tatraiva śāradātilake- sitājyamadhusaṃmiśraṃ guggulvagurucandanam | ṣaḍaṅgadhūpametattu sarvadevapriyaṃ sadā || 10 | ṣaḍakṣaramityādi | oṃ namaḥ śivāya iti | atra toḍalatantroktapramāṇantu nivedayiṣyate'ṣṭamapaṭale | gajāntaketi-aṣṭottarasahasramityarthaḥ | 11 | dhanadāmityādi | dhanadāprayogastu guptasādhanatantre navamapaṭale- śrīśiva uvāca | athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi dhanadāṃ sarvasiddhidām | yāmārādhya mahādevi kubero dhananāyakaḥ || dāntaṃ bindusamārūḍhaṃ mahāmāyāṃ haripriyām | ratipriye tataḥ paścād vahnijāyāṃ tataḥ priye || navākṣaro mahāmantro drutaṃ siddhipradāyakaḥ | kubero'sya ṛṣiḥ proktaḥ paṅktiśchanda udāhṛtam || devatā dhanadā devī sarvasiddhipradāyinī | dharmārthakāmamokṣākhyacaturvargaphalapradā || ṣaḍdīrghamāyayā caiva ṣaḍaṅganyāsamācaret | dhyānamasyāḥ pravakṣyāmi yena siddho bhavennaraḥ || oṃ devīṃ kāñcanakāntakāntivimalāṃ raktāṃśukācchāditāṃ hemāmbhojayugābhayāṅkuśakarīṃ ratnollasatkuṇḍalām | sarvābhīṣṭaphalapradāṃ trinayanāṃ nāgendrahāro-
pṛ0 24) dvādaśāhaṃ [japed kha-ga |]yajed dhīmān diksahasraṃ tato japet | taddaśāṃśaṃ maheśāni homaṃ [kuryād dvijottamaḥ gha-ṅa |]kuryyādvicakṣaṇaḥ || 12 || [-homakarmaṇyaśakta- kha-ga |]homakarmādyaśaktaśced dviguṇaṃ japamācaret | yadi prītā bhavet [sāpi ṅa |]sā hi tadā kiṃ vā na sidhyati || 13 || pratyahaṃ parameśāni kubero dīyate vasu | bhasmanirmāṇakaṃ [karma kha-ga |]devi vicitraṃ tasya kiṃ śive || 14 || gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dadyād yathāvibhavavistaraiḥ | tataḥ siddho bhavenmantrī nātra [kāryyavicāraṇā ṅa |]kāryyā vicāraṇā || 15 || [śrī nāsti ka-ṅa |]śrīcaṇḍikovāca- vidhānaṃ devadeveśa bhasmanirmāṇakarmmaṇi | [kṛtena rūpeṇa kha-ga, kṛte yena rūpeṇa ṅa |]sakṛtkṛte yena rūpe [bhasmasādayate ka |]bhasmasājjāyate vibho || 16 || ----------------- jjvalāṃ vande sarvabhayāpahāṃ trijagatāṃ pāpāpahārīṃ parām || svakīyātmasvarūpāṃ tāṃ bhāvayeccitsvarūpiṇīm | evaṃ dhyātvā maheśāni mānasaiḥ pūjanañcaret || arghyapātraṃ sthāpayitvā dhenuyoniṃ pradarśayet | pīṭhapūjāṃ tataḥ kṛtvā tataḥ pīṭhamanuṃ japet || ādhāraśaktimārabhya yajet padmāsanaṃ priye | praṇavādinamo'ntena pūjayet sādhakāgraṇīḥ || punardhyātvā maheśāni mūlenāvāhanañcaret | ṣaḍaṅgena ca saṃpūjya jīvanyāsaṃ samācaret || mūlamantraṃ samuccārya tato dravyaṃ samuccaret | devāyai ca tataḥ paścād yogātmakamanuṃ smaret || pādyādyaiḥ pūjayeddevīṃ yathāvibhavavistaraiḥ | yantramasyāḥ pravakṣyāmi tajjñātvāmṛtamaśnute || navayonyātmakaṃ cakraṃ vilikhet karṇikopari | dvidalaṃ padmamālikhya caturasraṃ tato bahiḥ || koṇeṣu varjaṃ saṃlikhya madhye bījaṃ samullikhet | idaṃ yantraṃ maheśāni sākṣād devīsvarūpakam || lakṣmīṃ padmāṃ padmālayāṃ śriyañcaiva harapriyām | śavāñca kamalāñcaiva abjāñca cañcalāntathā || lolāñca praṇavādyetā namo'ntena prapūjayet | punarmadhye tato devīṃ pūjayet sādhakottamaḥ || prāṇāyāmaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā yathāśakti japañcaret | guhyātīti japaphalaṃ devyā haste samarpayet || prāṇāyāmaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā praṇāmāṣṭāṅgamācaret | athotthāya maheśāni viśeṣārghyaṃ nivedayet || ātmasamarpaṇaṃ kṛtvā viharecca nijecchayā | iti |
pṛ0 25) [śrī nāsti ka-ṅa |]śrīśaṅkara uvāca- ānīya pāradaṃ devi ['sthāpaye'dityādi 'pāradaṃ devī'tyantoṃ'śaḥ kha-ga-pustakayornāsti |]sthāpayet prastaropari | tasyopari japenmantraṃ [sarvvabaddhamayātmakam ka, sarvabandhanamātmakam ṅa |]sarvvavandyanavātmakam || 17 || [sāṣṭaṃ gha |]sāṣṭasahasraṃ deveśi prajapet sādhakāgraṇīḥ | svayambhupuṣpasaṃyukte vastre cāruṇasannibhe || 18 || saṃsthāpya pāradaṃ devi mṛtpātrayugale śive | puṣpayuktena sūtreṇa badhnīyād bahuyatnataḥ || 19 || [mṛttikayā ca rajasā kha-ga, mṛttikayā rajenaiva gha-ṅa |]muktidhārājalenaiva [badhnīyāt ṅa |]dhānyasya parameśvari | lepayed bahuyatnena raudre [śuṣkāṇi ka-ṅa |]śuṣkañca kārayet || 20 || punaśca lepayed dhīmān tato vahnau vinikṣipet | aṣṭamīnavamīrātrau [nikṣipennaiva sundari kha-ga |]kṣipennaiva sureśvari || 21 || athavā parameśāni mṛtpātre sthāpayedrasam | vallīrasena taddravyaṃ śodhayed bahuyatnataḥ || 22 || [ghṛtakumārī- gha |]ghṛtanārīrasenaiva tathaiva śodhanañcaret | evaṃ kṛte tu guṭikāṃ yadi syād dṛḍhabandhanam || 23 || [dhustūraphala- ṅa |]dhustūrañca samānīya madhye śūnyañca kārayet | [kṛṣṇākhyā- ka-gha |]kṛṣṇākhyatulasīyoge tathā ghṛtakumārikā || 24 || ----------------- 17 | sarvvavandyetyādi- oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ klīṃ hlīṃ hrīṃ klīṃ namaḥ iti navākṣaramantra iti ṅa-pustaka-ṭippanyām |
pṛ0 26) evaṃ kṛte vahniyoge bhasmasājjāyate kila | [bhasmayogaṃ ka |]bhasmayoge bhavet svarṇaṃ dhanadāyāḥ prasādataḥ || 25 || vivarṇaṃ jāyate dravyaṃ yadi pūjāṃ na [cārayet ṅa |]cācaret || 26 || [śrī nāsti ka |]śrīcaṇḍikovāca- [svayambhū kha-ga, svayambhuṃ ka-ṅa |]svayambhu kīdṛśaṃ nātha kuṇḍagolantu[-golañca kha-ga |] kīdṛśam | [idamarddhaṃ ka-kha-ga-pustakeṣu nāsti, khapuṣpaṃ ṅa |]svapuṣpaṃ kīdṛśaṃ nātha vajrapuṣpantu kīdṛśam | sarvvakālodbhavaṃ nātha kīdṛśaṃ vada śaṅkara || 27 || [śrī nāsti ka-ṅa |]śrīśaṅkara uvāca- vivāharahitā kanyā [prathame ṛtusaṃyutā kha-ga, prathamā ṅa |]prathamaṃ puṣpasaṃyutā | tacchoṇitaṃ maheśāni svayambhu[svayambhuṃ ka, svayambhū- kha-ga |] nātra saṃśayaḥ || 28 || bharttari [varttate devi gha, bharttate devi ka-ṅa |]vidyamāne tu [kanyāyāścaivasundari kha-ga |]yā kanyā [cānyagā gha |]cānyajā śive | tadudbhavaṃ kuṇḍapuṣpaṃ sarvvakāryyārthasādhakam[-sādhanam kha-ga, sādhakaḥ ka-gha |] || 29 || mṛte bharttari [yā devi kha-ga |]deveśi yā kanyā [jāyate priye ka-gha-ṅa |]anyajā śive | tadudbhavaṃ golapuṣpaṃ devavaśyakaraṃ param || 30 || [kha-ga-pustakayoḥ ayaṃ śloko nāsti |]vivāhitāyāḥ kanyāyāḥ prathame ṛtusambhave | tacchoṇitaṃ maheśāni [kha-puṣpaṃ ṅa |]svapuṣpaṃ sarvamohanam || 31 || vivāhitāyāḥ kanyāyāḥ puruṣasya [tu kha-ga |]ca tāḍanāt | yadi puṣpaṃ samudbhūtaṃ vajraṃ tat parikīrttitam || 32 ||
pṛ0 27) vivāhitāyāḥ kanyāyāḥ pratimāse ca yad bhavet | sarvvakālodbhavaṃ puṣpaṃ kathitaṃ vīravandite || 33 || saptakrośaṃ vahnimadhye sthāpayed bahuyatnataḥ | [utthāpitaṃ kha-ga |]tata utthāya [taṃ dravyaṃ ka-kha-ga-ṅa |]tad dravyaṃ svarṇapātre nidhāya ca || 34 || prajapet parameśāni [prasādākhyaṃ kha |]prāsādākhyaṃ mahāmanum | tataḥ siddho bhavenmantrī nānyathā mama bhāṣitam || 35 || etanmantraṃ maheśāni [gajāṇḍaka- kha-ga |]gajāntakasahasrakam | japitvā pūjayet paścāt pārthivaṃ śivaliṅgakam || 36 || tataḥ parīkṣā karttavyā śṛṇu matprāṇavallabhe | śuddhatāmraṃ vahnimadhye mṛtpātre tolakaṃ [sitaṃ ka-gha-ṅa |]mitam || 37 || dravībhūte ca tāmre ca [śukramānaṃ kha-ga, guñjāmātraṃ ṅa |]guñjāmānaṃ kṣiped yadi | tatkṣaṇe[-kṣaṇāt kha-ga |] parameśāni svarṇaṃ bhavati niścitam || 38 || guñjāpramāṇaṃ[-mātraṃ tu ṅa |] tad dravyaṃ bhojanaṃ kurute yadi | [sarvarogaiḥ pari- kha-ga, sarvarogaṃ parityaktvā gha |]sarvarogaparityakto jāyate madanopamaḥ | mantrasiddhirbhavettasya jāyate [cirajīvitaḥ kha-ga, cirajīvatā gha |]cirajīvitā || 39 || pratyahaṃ parameśāni śatanārīṃ[-nārī kha-ga-gha |] ramed yadi | vīryyādirahitaṃ na syāt tejovṛddhikaraṃ param[-vṛddhiḥ parasparam ka-ga-ṅa |] || 40 || ---------- 34 | saptakrośamiti-krośaṃ praharam iti ṅa-ṭippanyām | 35 | prāsādākhyamityādi | sāntamaukārasaṃyuktaṃ bindubhūṣitamastakam | prāsādākhyo manuḥ prokto bhajatāṃ kāmado maṇiḥ || tena hauṃ iti mantrakoṣaḥ | 36 | gajāntakasahasrakam-aṣṭottarasahasramityarthaḥ |
pṛ0 28) [savarṇaṃ kha-ga |]maraṇaṃ naiva paśyāmi yadi [vyāla- kha-ga |]dhyānayuto bhavet | tasya vittaṃ vilokyaiva kubero'pi tiraskṛtaḥ || 41 || gānena tumburuḥ sākṣād dānena vāsavo yathā | maheśa iva [yogīśo kha-ga |]yogīndro [nirṛte- ṅa |]nirṛtiriva durdharaḥ || 42 || mahābalo mahāvīryyo mahāsāhasikaḥ śuciḥ | mahāsvaccho dayāvāṃśca sarvaprāṇihite rataḥ | bahu kiṃ kathyate devi sa eva gaṇanāyakaḥ || 43 ||
iti śrīmātṛkābhedatantre [caṇḍikāśaṅkara- gha |]haragaurīsaṃvāde pañcamaḥ paṭalaḥ || 5 ||
pṛ0 29) ṣaṣṭhaḥ paṭalaḥ |
śrīcaṇḍikovāca- vada īśāna sarvvajña sarvatattvavidāṃ vara | mahāroge mahāduḥkhe mahādāridryasaṅkaṭe || 1 || nānāvyādhigate vāpi nānāpīḍādisaṅkaṭe | [rājadhvaṃse kha-ga |]rājyanāśe rājabhaye kārāgāragate punaḥ || 2 || rājadaṇḍe[tathā grahapīḍane ca jalavahnisamākule kha-ga, rājñi kuṇḍe ca gha, rājñaḥ kupte ṅa |] ca deveśa tathā ca grahapīḍite[-pīḍane ṅa |] | kenopāyena[-pāye drutaṃ nātha ka-ṅa, pāyena he nātha gha |] deveśa mucyate vada śaṅkara || 3 || [śrī nāsti ka, īśvara gha |]śrīśaṅkara uvāca- śṛṇu cārvaṅgi subhage yanmāṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi | [etat gha |]tattat sarvaṃ pravakṣyāmi sāvadhānāvadhāraya || 4 || yā cādyā paramā vidyā cāmuṇḍā kālikā [smṛtā kha-ga |]parā | [yogamātreṇa subhage kha-ga |]tasyāḥ prayogamātreṇa kiṃ na sidhyati bhūtale || 5 || [śrī nāsti ka-ṅa |]śrīcaṇḍikovāca- rāhuścāṇḍālo[-la-vikhyātaḥ ka-gha-ṅa |] vikhyātaḥ [sarvavit kha-ga |]sarvvatra parameśvara | puṇyakālaḥ[-kālaṃ kha-ga-ṅa-prā |] kathaṃ [nātha gha |]deva tasya sparśe divākare || 6 || niśākare tathā [deva gha |]nātha [ceti ka-gha-ṅa |]iti me saṃśayo hṛdi | [kathamasya gha |]kathayasva [mahādeva kha-ga |]parānanda paścādanyat prakāśaya || 7 ||
pṛ0 30) [śrī nāsti ka-ṅa |]śrīśaṅkara uvāca- śṛṇu cārvaṅgi subhage [prayoga- kha-ga-prā |]grahaṇañcottamottamam[-mottamaḥ gha |] | grahaṇaṃ trividhaṃ devi candrasūryāgnisaṃyutam || 8 || śakterlalāṭake[-cakre ca kha-ga, -ṭe netre ca gha-prā |] netre vahnistiṣṭhati sarvadā | vāmanetre tathā candro dakṣe sūryaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ || 9 || śambhunāthena deveśi ramaṇaṃ kriyate [yadi prā |]yadā | tadaiva[tathaiva kha-ga, tadeva gha |] grahaṇaṃ devi śaktiyukto[-yuktaḥ sadā kha-ga-prā |] yadā śivaḥ || 10 || vāmanetre [cumbite ca prā |]cumbane tu śaśāṅkagrahaṇaṃ tadā | dakṣanetre [cumbite ca prā |]cumbane ca bhāskaragrahaṇaṃ [tathā prā |]tadā || 11 || lalāṭe [cumbite prā |]cumbane cāgnigrahaṇaṃ parameśvari | śivavīryaṃ[-bījaṃ kha-ga-ṅa-prā |] yato vahnirato'dṛśyaḥ[-'dṛśyaṃ kha-ga |] sureśvari || 12 || [kha-ga-pustakayorayaṃ śloko nāsti |]rāhuḥ [śivaṃ ṅa |]śivaḥ samākhyātastriguṇā śaktirīritā | śivaśaktyoḥ samāyogo[-yogād prā |] grahaṇaṃ parameśvari || 13 || [śivaśakteḥ kha-ga, śivaśaktyoḥ ka |]śivaśaktisamāyogaḥ [kālo prā |]kālaṃ brahmamayaṃ[-mayaḥ śive prā |] priye | ata eva maheśāni rāśyādīn na vicārayet || 14 || tithinakṣatra[-yoge ca kha-ga, -yoge tu prā |]yogena [yathāyogaṃ maheśvari prā |]yadyogaṃ parameśvari | [tadeva kha-ga-prā |]tadaiva parameśāni rāśyādigaṇanañcaret || 15 || -------------- 13 | triguṇā śaktiriti | candrasūryyāgnirūpiṇītyartha iti ṅa-pustakaṭippanyām |
pṛ0 31) śivaśaktisamāyogāt sarvvaṃ brahmamayaṃ jagat | māsapakṣatithīnāñca [noccāryya kha-ga |]noccāryyaṃ parameśvari || 16 || dṛṣṭimātreṇa japtavyaṃ tadā [siddho bhavet ka-gha |]siddhirbhaved dhruvam | tatkālaṃ paramaṃ [kāmaṃ ṅa |]kālaṃ vijñeyaṃ vīravandite || 17 || tatra yadyat kṛtaṃ [karma ananta- kha-ga-prā |]sarvvamanantaphalamīritam | [pūrve ca kha-ga-prā |]puraiva kathitaṃ sarvaṃ bahu kiṃ kathyate'dhunā || 18 || etat suguptabhedaṃ hi tava snehāt prakāśitam | na vaktavyaṃ paśoragre [prāṇānte'pi kha-ga-prā |]na vaktavyaṃ sureśvari || 19 || [etat sarvaṃ ṅa |]etattattvaṃ prayatnena brahmā jānāti mādhavaḥ | pragoptavyaṃ prayatnena svayoniriva [pārvati kha-ga |]śailaje || 20 || śrīcaṇḍikovāca- cāmuṇḍāyā mahāmantraṃ kīdṛśaṃ [vada śaṅkara kha-ga |]parameśvara | ārādhanaṃ kīdṛśaṃ vā tad vadasva dayānidhe || 21 || śrīśaṅkara uvāca- śṛṇu cārvvaṅgi subhage cāmuṇḍāmantramuttamam | yasya vijñānamātreṇa punarjjanma na vidyate || 22 || -------------- 18 | tatra yad yadityādi | atrānantaphalakīrttanād japadaśāṃśahomādikamapi na karttavyaṃ | taduktaṃ gāyatrītantre prathamapaṭale- candrasūryyoparāge ca japtvā brahmamayo bhavet | mantrasya parameśāni na ca homādikañcaret || kṛte homādike bhadre tajjapaṃ viphalaṃ bhavet | japamātre maheśāni anantastanmanuryathā || anantasya maheśāni daśāṃśaṃ kena jāyate | iti | etatkalpastu jñāninām iti prāṇatoṣaṇī |
pṛ0 32) kālībījayugaṃ devī kūrccabījaṃ tataḥ param | tryakṣarī [sā mahā- gha |]paramā vidyā cāmuṇḍā kālikā svayam || 23 || saptāhaṃ pūjayed devīmupacāraiśca ṣoḍaśaiḥ | pūjānte prajapenmantraṃ trisahasraṃ varānane || 24 || rātrau [ca ṅa |]tu pañcatattvena pūjayet parameśvarīm | tathā rātrau japenmantraṃ kulaśaktisamanvitam || 25 || yantranirmāṇayogyaṃ hi pīṭhaṃ [kuryyāt kha-ga |]dadyāt suvistaram | bhogayogyaṃ pradātavyaṃ madhuparkaṃ yathocitam || 26 || śakteryathā vidheyaṃ syād yuvatyāḥ parameśvari | tathā vastraṃ pradātavyaṃ sarvakalyāṇahetave || 27 || alaṅkāraṃ yathāyogyaṃ [tava devyai nivedayet gha |]tatra tatra niyojayet | naivedyaṃ vividhaṃ ramyaṃ nānādravyasamanvitam || 28 || sāmiṣānnaṃ pradātavyaṃ paramānnaṃ saśarkaram | pūjayet parayā bhaktyā balidānaṃ tataḥ param || 29 || ---------------- 23 | kālībījayugamityādi | tena krīṃ krīṃ hūṃ iti mantro bhavati iti ṅa-pustakaṭippanyām | 25 | rātrau tu pañcatattveneti | pañcatattvamuktaṃ guptasādhanatantre saptamapaṭale- śrīśiva uvāca | śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi tattvaṃ paramadurlabham | mantroddhārakrameṇaiva tat sarvaṃ kathayāmi te || bhāntamakārasaṃyuktaṃ thāntaṃ vāyuyutaṃ kuru | binduyuktaṃ punarbhrāntamākāraṃ bindusaṃyutam || candrabījaṃ samuccāryya aṃkāraṃ tadanantaram | punarbhāntaṃ takārañca candravāyuyutaṃ śive || punarbhāntaṃ maheśāni pañcamasvarasaṃyutam | thāntaṃ vahnisamārūḍhamākārasaṃyutaṃ kuru | punarbhāntaṃ maheśāni sūryyasvaravibhūṣitam | tāntamukārasaṃyuktaṃ dhāntamabindusaṃyutam || pañcatattvamidaṃ devi sarvvatantreṣu gopitam || iti | kālīkulārṇave ca- madyaṃ māṃsaṃ tathā matsyaṃ mudrā maithunameva ca | pañcamāt tu paraṃ nāsti śāktānāṃ bhogamokṣayoḥ || iti |
pṛ0 33) pratyahaṃ parameśāni [ādyante kha-ga, cādyānteva gha |]cādyante [vāruṇīṃ kha-ga |]vā baliṃ haret | sāṅge jāte maheśāni cāthavā [vāruṇīṃ haret kha-ga |]balimāharet || 30 || evaṃ kṛte [mahāsiddhirla- ka-gha-ṅa |]mahāsiddhiṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ | dhanārthī dhanamāpnoti putrārthī putravān bhavet || 31 || vivāde jayamāpnoti rājadvāre jayī bhavet | sarvatra vijayī bhūtvā devīputra iva kṣitau || 32 || rogebhyo ghorarūpebhyaḥ pūjayitvā pramucyate | [iti siddhi- gha |]icchāsiddhirbhavet tasya sarvasiddhirna cānyathā || 33 || kārāgāragate[-gārāgate ka-gha-ṅa |] [cāpi ṅa |]devi mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ | prayogaṃ parameśāni sāraṃ paramadurlabham || 34 || atisnehena deveśi tava sthāne prakāśitam | athavā parameśāni paṭheccaṇḍīṃ [purā- kha-ga |]sanātanīm || 35 || [pūjayeccaṇḍikādevīṃ kha-ga |]pūjayeccaṇḍikāṃ devīṃ sugandhipuṣpasaṃyutaiḥ | dhūpadīpena gandhena naivedyena sureśvari || 36 || avaśyaṃ pañcatattvena pūjayeccaṇḍikāṃ parām || 37 || ādāvṛṣyādi-[-sūtreṇa ka-gha-ṅa |]sūktena [cādyante kha-ga, cāryyānte ka|]cārghyānte parameśvari | pañcatattvaṃ samānīya śodhayecchāstravittamaḥ[-yenmantravi- kha-ga-gha-ṅa |] || 38 || -------------- 37 | pañcatattvenetyādi | tattvaśodhanamuktaṃ mahānirvāṇatantre aṣṭamollāse- āsādayet tu tattvāni sthāpayedagrataḥ śive | tārādiprāṇabījāntaṃ śatāvṛttyā japan manum || sarvatattveṣu cakreśa imaṃ mantramudīrayet | brahmārpaṇaṃ brahma havirbrahmāgnaurbrahmaṇā hutam || brahmaiva tena gantavyaṃ
pṛ0 34) tarpaṇañca tataḥ kṛtvā cārghyapātre vinikṣipet | arghyodakena saṃprokṣya pūjayet pīṭhadevatām || 39 || praṇavañca samuddhṛtya māyābījaṃ tataḥ param | prabhāṃ māyāṃ [tamāṃ ka |]jayāṃ sūkṣmāṃ viśuddhāṃ [nandanīṃ kha-ga, nalinīṃ ka |]nandinīṃ tathā || 40 || suprabhāṃ vijayāṃ sarvasiddhidāṃ paripūjayet | [vajranakha tathā daṃṣṭrāyudhāya hūṃ phaḍiti tataḥ ka, vajranakhadaṃṣṭrāyudhāya hūṃ phaḍityapi kha-ga |]vajranakhadaṃṣṭrāyudhāya hūṃ phaḍityantatastataḥ || 41 || namo'ntena[-ntenaiva mantreṇa kha-ga, nama antena gha |] tu deveśi āsanañca samarccayet | gurupaṅktiṃ pūjayitvā punardhyānaṃ samācaret || 42 || āvāhanaṃ tato mudrāṃ jīvanyāsaṃ prapūjanam | [ṣaḍaṅgamaṇḍalaṃ pūjya gha |]ṣaḍaṅgena tu sampūjya parivārān prapūjayet || 43 || śaṅkhanidhiṃ [tathā padmanidhiṃ brāhmādikaṃ ka-gha-ṅa |]padmanidhiṃ tathā brāhmyādikaṃ yajet | [indrādīṃśca tathā vajrādīṃścaiva paripūjayet ka-gha-ṅa |]indrādīṃścaiva vajrādīn pūjayet sādhakottamaḥ || 44 || praṇavādinamo'ntena pūjayet sādhakottamaḥ | punardevīṃ maheśāni pañcatattvena pūjayet || 45 || ------------- brahmakarmasamādhinā | saptadhā vā tridhā japtvā tāni sarvāṇi śodhayet || tato brāhmeṇa manunā samarpya paramātmane | brahmajñaiḥ sādhakaiḥ sārddhaṃ vidadhyāt pānabhojanam || iti | tatraiva pañcamapaṭale- madyaṃ māṃsaṃ tathā matsyaṃ mudrā maithunameva ca | śaktipūjāvidhāvādye pañcatattvaṃ prakīrttitam || pañcatattvaṃ vinā pūjā abhicārāya kalpate | neṣṭasiddhirbhavet tasya vighnastasya pade pade || śilāyāṃ śasyavāpe ca yathā naivāṅkuro bhavet | pañcatattvavihīnāyāṃ pūjāyāṃ na phalodbhavaḥ || iti pañcatattvaiḥ pūjāyāḥ prāśastyamuktam |
pṛ0 35) prāṇāyāmaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā gurumantreṣṭadevatām | aikyaṃ vibhāvya deveśi mūlamantraṃ [japet sudhīḥ kha-ga |]japecchatam || 46 || prāṇāyāmaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā kāraṇādīn samāharet | tasyai dattvā svayaṃ pītvā paṭheccaṇḍīṃ sureśvari[-rīm kha-ga-gha |] || 47 || sāṅge jāte tu [māhātmyam kha-ga |]māhātmye punaḥ pānaṃ samācaret | [tatastatsat paṭhed gha |]tatastu prapaṭhed dhīmān krameṇa [paripūjayet kha-ga |]pānamācaret || 48 || samāpte tu [viromeṇa ka |]vilomena [mūlamantraṃ ka-gha-ṅa |]punarmmantraṃ śataṃ japet | yadi bhāgyavaśād devi śaktiyogaṃ[-yogo bhavennaraḥ kha-ga, -yogo ka-ṅa |] labhennaraḥ || 49 || [tatkṣaṇāddhi kha-ga |]tatkṣaṇe hi vijānīyāt sarvasiddhiḥ kare sthitā | evaṃ kṛtvā maheśāni yadi pāṭhaṃ samācaret || 50 || māhātmyaṃ tasya pāṭhasya [na vaktuṃ kha-ga |]kiṃ vaktuṃ śakyate mayā | [padyārddhamidaṃ nāsti kha-ga-pustakayoḥ |]śatavaktraṃ yadi bhavet tadā vaktuṃ na śakyate || 51 || pañcavaktreṇa deveśi kiṃ [mayā kathyate'- kha-ga-gha-ṅa |]vaktuṃ śakyate'dhunā | sakṛt pāṭhena deveśi kiṃ punarbrahma kevalam || 52 || avaśyaṃ labhate śāntiṃ [sarvvatra parameśvari, yadi śāntiṃ na labhate ityaṃśaḥ kha-ga-pustakayornāsti |]sarvatra parameśvari | yadi śāntiṃ na labhate mama vākyaṃ mṛṣā [kadā kha-ga |]tadā || 53 || ṣoḍaśenopacāreṇa prathamaṃ pūjanañcaret | dvitīye pañcatattvena pūjayeccaṇḍikāṃ priye || 54 ||
pṛ0 36) sahasrāvṛttipāṭhena yat phalaṃ labhate naraḥ | sakṛt pāṭhasya deveśi kalāṃ nārhati ṣoḍaśīm || 55 || dhyānamasyāḥ pravakṣyāmi yathā dhyātvā paṭhennaraḥ || 56 ||
oṃ yā caṇḍī madhukaiṭabhādidaityadalanī yā māhiṣonmādinī yā dhūmrekṣaṇacaṇḍamuṇḍamathanī yā raktabījāśanī | śaktiḥ śumbhaniśumbhadaityadalanī yā [svarga- kha-ga |]siddhilakṣmīḥ parā sā devī [navakoṭiśakti- gha |]navakoṭimūrttisahitā māṃ pātu viśveśvarī || 57 || [idamarddhaṃ ka-gha-ṅa-pustakeṣu nāsti |]dhyānametaccaṇḍikāyāḥ śṛṇuṣva vīravandite || 58 || [śṛṇuṣva taṃ kha-ga |]śṛṇu mantraṃ [maheśāni kha-ga-gha |]pravakṣyāmi trailokyeṣu ca durlabham | vedādyaṃ [vāgbhavaṃ bījaṃ māyāṃ kāmamataḥ ṅa |]vāgbhavaṃ [māyā gha |]māyāṃ kāmabījaṃ tataḥ param || 59 || sthiramāyāṃ mahāmāyāṃ kāmabījaṃ[kāmamāyāṃ gha |] tato namaḥ | navākṣaraṃ mahāmantraṃ japedādau śataṃ priye || 60 || viparītaṃ mahāmantraṃ pāṭhānte tu śataṃ japet | śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi ṛṣicchandaḥ[-cchandaṃ ka-gha-ṅa |] [anuttamam ṅa |]sudurlabham || 61 || oṃ saptaśatīmahāstotrasya [medhyādi- gha |]medhātithirṛṣirgāyatryanuṣṭubbṛhatīpaṅktitriṣṭubjagatya[-jagatyuṣṇiṅmahatya- kha-ga |]śchandāṃsi mahākālīmahālakṣmīrmahā- ------------- 59 | vedādyamityādi | tena oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ klīṃ hīṃ hrīṃ klīṃ namaḥ iti mantro bhavati | 61 | viparītamityādi | tena namaḥ klīṃ hrīṃ hīṃ klīṃ hrīṃ aiṃ oṃ iti mantro bhavati |
pṛ0 37) sarasvatīdevatā-[stavakavacaṃ ka |]stavakaṃ, aiṃ hrīṃ klīṃ bījāni[bījaṃ ka-kha-ga-gha |] kṣrauṃ[krīṃ kha-ga |] śaktiḥ [mamātmaka- kha-ga |]mamāmukakāmasiddhyarthe[-siddhyarthe caṇḍīpāṭhe, -rthapāṭhe gha |] [jape vini- ṅa |]viniyogaḥ || 62 || praṇavena maheśāni ṣaḍaṅganyāsamācaret | iti te kathitaṃ kānte caṇḍīpāṭhasya lakṣaṇam || 63 || sāvarṇiḥ sūryya [-tanayaḥ kha-ga |]ityādi sāvarṇirbhavitā manuḥ | etanmātraṃ paṭheddevi kiñcinnyūnādhikaṃ na hi || 64 || vāratrayaṃ [mahā- ṅa |]paṭheddevi [sthāpyate tad kha-ga, saṃvyāpyaṃ tu gha-ṅa |]saṃjapyaṃ tu dinatrayam || 65 || mahāroge mahāduḥkhe rājapīḍādidāruṇe | nānāvyādhigate vāpi rājyanāśe tathā bhaye || 66 || grahapīḍādisaṃjāte brahmahatyādipātake | evaṃ pāṭhena deveśi mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 67 || bahu kiṃ kathyate devi sarvvaśāntiṃ[-śāntirbhaved dhruvam gha |] labhennaraḥ | sarvaśaṅkāvinirmukto jāyate madanopamaḥ || 68 || evaṃ kṛte maheśāni yadi siddhirna jāyate | punastenaiva karttavyaṃ tataḥ siddho bhaved dhruvam || 69 ||
iti śrīmātṛkābhedatantre[-tantra sarvatantrottamottame kha-ga | -tantre ṣaṣṭhaḥ gha |] harapārvvatīsaṃvāde ṣaṣṭhaḥ paṭalaḥ || 6 ||
pṛ0 38) saptamaḥ paṭalaḥ |
[śrīśaṅkara kha-ga |]śrīśiva uvāca- athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi tripurāmantramuttamam | yasya vijñānamātreṇa punarjjanma na vidyate || 1 || tripurā trividhā devī bālā [coktā gha-ṅa |]proktā [tathā kha-ga |]purā śive | tathaiva bhairavī devī nityātantre mayoditā | idānīṃ [sundarī devī gha |]sundarīṃ devīṃ śṛṇu pārvati sādaram || 2 || [śrīpārvatyuvāca kha-ga, śrī nāsti ṅa |]śrīdevyuvāca- mahāmantraṃ śrutaṃ nātha [vāmakeśe ca ṅa |]vāmakeśvarayāmale | prātaḥkṛtyādi deveśa [ārādhanaṃ gha |]ārādhanakramaṃ vada || 3 || [nāsti gha-pustake | śiva uvāca ṅa |]śrīśiva uvāca- [prātaḥkāle samutthāya ṅa |]prātarutthāya mantrajñaḥ sahasrāre nijaṃ gurum | pūrvoktadhyānamuccāryya[-mācaryya kha-ga |] pūjayed bahuyatnataḥ || 4 || tathā ca [strīguro- ṅa |]śrīgurordhyānaṃ guptasādhanatantrake | kathitañca mayā pūrvaṃ mantraṃ śṛṇu varānane || 5 || ----------------------- 5 | tathā cetyādi | śrīgurordhyānamuktaṃ guptasādhanatantre dvitīyapaṭale- śrīśaṅkara uvāca ......kulavṛkṣān namaskṛtya guruṃ dhyāyet parāmbuje | śaraccandrasamābhāsaṃ śaratpaṅkajalocanam || īṣaddhāsyaṃ śāradīyapūrṇendusadṛśānanam | divyasragambaradharaṃ divyagandhānulepanam || suraktaśaktisaṃyuktavāmabhāgamanoharam | varābhayakarāmbhojaṃ sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitam || sahasrāre

pṛ0 43) pūjayāmi tathā corddhvaṃ namaścādhaḥ sadā'vatu | iti te kathitaṃ kānte kavacaṃ paramādbhutam || 35 || gurumantraṃ [paṭhitvā ca kha-ga |]japitvā tu kavacaṃ prapaṭhed yadi | sa siddhaḥ [suguṇaḥ kha-ga |]sagaṇaḥ so'pi [śiva eva na prā |]śivaḥ sākṣānna saṃśayaḥ || 36 || pūjākāle paṭhed yastu kavacaṃ mantravigraham | pūjāphalaṃ [labhet kha-ga |]bhavet tasya satyaṃ satyaṃ sureśvari || 37 || [kha-ga-pustakayornāsti |]trisandhyaṃ yaḥ paṭhed devi sa siddho nātra saṃśayaḥ || 38 || bhūrjje vilikhya [gulikāṃ ṅa-prā0 |]guṭikāṃ svarṇasthāṃ dhārayed yadi | tasya darśanamātreṇa vādino niṣprabhāṃ[niṣprabhā matāḥ |] gatāḥ || 39 || vivāde jayamāpnoti [raṇe ca ityā'rabhya jayamāpnoti ityantoṃ'śaḥ kha-ga-pustakayornāsti |]raṇe ca [nirṛteḥ samaḥ ṅa-prā, nairṛte ta0pa0 |]nirṛtiriva | sabhāyāṃ jayamāpnoti mama tulyo na saṃśayaḥ || 40 || sahasrāre [bhāvayetāṃ gha |]bhāvayaṃ [taṃ kha-ga, yaḥ ta0pa0prā |]stāṃ trisandhyaṃ [yaḥ paṭhet kha-ga |]prapaṭhed yadi | sa eva [siddhalo- prā |]siddho lokeśo[loke'smin kha-ga |] [nirvāṇe nīyate tu saḥ gha |]nirvāṇapadamīhate[-padalīyate ka, -mīyate ṅa-ta0pa0prā | ] || 41 || samastamaṅgalaṃ nāma kavacaṃ paramādbhutam | yasmai kasmai na dātavyaṃ na prakāśyaṃ kadācana || 42 || deyaṃ śiṣyāya śāntāya cānyathā patanaṃ[viphalaṃ ta0pa0 |] bhavet | abhaktebhyo'pi[-bhyastu ta0pa0, -bhyaśca prā |]deveśi putrebhyo'pi na darśayet || 43 ||

[pārvatyuvāca kha-ga |]śrīdevyuvāca- śṛṇu nātha parānanda parāparakulātmaka | tvāṃ vinā [nātra karttā gha |]trāṇakarttā ca mama jñāne na varttate || 1 || [pūrṇaliṅgamityādi na varttate ityantoṃ'śaḥ kha-ga-pustakayornāsti |]pūrṇaliṅgaṃ maheśāna śivabījaṃ na cānyathā | [śilāmadhya ityādi na varttate ityantoṃ'śo gha-pustake nāsti |]śilāmadhye tathā cakraṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ param || 2 || pāradasya śatāṃśaikaṃ mama jñāne na varttate | śivabījaṃ mahādeva śivarūpaṃ na cānyathā | [liṅgaṃ rūpaṃ gha |]liṅgarūpaṃ [mahādeva ṅa |]kathaṃ deva tad vadasva [dayānidhe ga |]mayi prabho || 3 || [śaṅkara kha-ga |]śrīśiva uvāca- [jyotirmayaṃ mahāliṅgaṃ śa0 |]yathā jyotirmayaṃ liṅgaṃ kailāsaśikhare[-nagare priye ka-gha-ṅa |] mama | tasyaiva ṣoḍaśāṃśaikaḥ kāśyāṃ [viśveśvarasthitaṃ ṅa-kha-ga |]viśveśvaraḥ sthitaḥ[ataḥ paraṃ kha-ga-pustakayoḥ pāradaḥ ṣoḍaśāṃśaika kāśyāṃ viśveśvarasthitam ityadhikaḥ |] || 4 || [pūrvabījaṃ kha-ga, pūrṇabījaṃ ṅa |]pūrṇaliṅgaṃ maheśāni [śivarūpaṃ kha-ga |]śivabījaṃ na cānyathā | śilāmadhye [ca yaccakraṃ kha-ga, yathā gha |]tathā cakraṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ[-yaṇaḥ śa |] [smṛtam kha-ga |]param || 5 || pāradasya śatāṃśaikaṃ[-śaikaḥ lakṣmīnārāyaṇo śa |] lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ na hi | [prakāraṃ kha-ga |]pakāraṃ viṣṇurūpañca ākāraṃ[cākālaṃ gha |] kālikā tathā[svayaṃ kha-ga-ṅa-śa |] || 6 ||
pṛ0 51) rephaṃ śivaṃ dakārañca brahmarūpaṃ na cānyathā | pāradaṃ parameśāni brahmaviṣṇuśivātmakam || 7 || yo yajet[japet kha-ga, -'rccayet ṅa |] pāradaṃ liṅgaṃ sa eva śambhuravyayaḥ[ataḥ paraṃ ka-kha-ga-ṅa-pustakeṣu ājanmamadhye yo devi ekadā yadi pūjayet ityadhikaḥ |] | sa eva dhanyo deveśi sa jñānī sa tu tattvavit || 8 || sa brahmavettā sa dhanī sa rājā bhuvi pūjitaḥ[bhūri pūjya saḥ ka, bhuvi pūjya saḥ gha-ṅa |] | aṇimādivibhūtīnāmīśvaraḥ sādhakottamaḥ || 9 || striyaḥ svabhāvacapalā[-capalād- ka-ṅa |] gopituṃ na hi śakyate | ata eva hi deveśi viratā bhava pārvvati || 10 || śrīdevyuvāca- kathayasva kṛpānātha karuṇā yadi varttate | tava vākyaṃ vinā [nātha kha-ga |]deva kva[ka uktaḥ kaśca śabditaḥ kha-ga, kā muktiḥ kva ca sādhutā gha-ṅa |] muktiḥ kva ca sādhutā || 11 || śrīśiva uvāca- pāradaṃ [mama kha-ga |]śivabījaṃ hi tāḍanaṃ [naiva, kha-ga |]na hi kārayet | tāḍanādvittanāśaḥ syāt tāḍanāt [vitta- śa0 |]sutahīnatā | tāḍanādrogayuktaḥ syāt tāḍanānmaraṇaṃ bhavet || 12 || [pārvvatyuvāca kha-ga |]śrīdevyuvāca- etadvighnādikaṃ nātha satyameva na saṃśayaḥ | vighnādirahitaṃ nātha kathayasva dayānidhe || 13 ||
pṛ0 52) śrīśiva uvāca- pārade śivanirmāṇe nānāvighnaṃ yataḥ śive[ataḥ paraṃ gha-pustake nānāvighnaṃ bhaveddevi tatra bhaktiyutaḥ śive ityadhikaḥ pāṭhaḥ |] | ata eva hi tatrādau śānti-svastyayanañcaret || 14 || dvādaśaṃ pārthivaṃ liṅgamupacāraiśca ṣauḍaśaiḥ | paṭṭādisūtranirmāṇaṃ[nirmmāṇaracitaṃ śa |] racitaṃ śuklameva vā[ca kha-ga |] || 15 || puruṣasya yathāyogyaṃ [vastrayugmaṃ kha-ga, yugmaṃ vastraṃ ṅa |]yugmavastraṃ nivedayet | bhogayogyaṃ pradātavyaṃ madhuparkaṃ [maheśvari ṅa, kuleśvari śa |]sureśvari || 16 || alaṅkāraṃ yathāśakti dadyāt kalyāṇahetave | pūjayed bahuyatnena bilvapatreṇa pārvati || 17 || toḍaloktena vidhinā [pratyekamayutaṃ kha-ga |]pratyekenāyutaṃ japet | ādau pañcākṣaraṃ mantramaṣṭottaraśataṃ japet || 18 || pūjānte prajapet paścāt prāsādākhyaṃ mahāmanum | dakṣiṇāntaṃ samācaryya[samuccāryya kha-ga, samācāryya ṅa |] haviṣyāśī jitendriyaḥ || 19 || tāmbūlañca tathā matsyaṃ varjayenna kadācana | [tasmi- kha-ga-gha |]asmiṃstantre haviṣyānnaṃ tāmbūlaṃ mīnamuttamam || 20 || ---------------- 15 | dvādaśamityādi | liṅgapūjādhāraniyamaśca mahiṣamardinītantre trayodaśapaṭale- svarṇapātre tathā raupye tāmre ca prastare tathā | padmapatre palāśe ca tathā vā kadalīdale || pūjanaṃ mṛnmayaṃ liṅgaṃ kāśīkṣetrasamaṃ priye | taijase dārave pātre sāmānyaphaladaṃ sadā || anyat pātrañca cārvaṅgi varjayecchivapūjane | iti | 18 | toḍaloktenetyādi | taduktaṃ toḍalatantre pañcamapaṭale- namaskāraṃ samuddhṛtya vāntaṃ netravibhūṣitam | vāruṇaṃ mukhavṛttañca vāyuṃ lalāṭasaṃyutam || ayaṃ pañcākṣaro mantraḥ pañcāmnāyaphalapradaḥ | etena namaḥ śivāya iti mantro bhavati | praṇavādiryadā devi tadā mantraḥ ṣaḍakṣaraḥ | etena ca oṃ namaḥ śivāya iti ṣaḍakṣaro mantraḥ |
pṛ0 53) homayet parameśāni daśāṃśaṃ vā śatāṃśakam | homasya dakṣiṇā kāryyā tadā vighnairna lipyate || 21 || tataḥ parasmin divase pāradamānayed budhaḥ[sudhīḥ kha-ga-gha-śa0 |] | tasyopari japenmantraṃ [sarvvabandha- ka-kha-ga, -sarvvabaddha- ṅa |]sarvvavandyanavātmakam || 22 || vyomabījaṃ [śivārṇañca śa |]śivāntañca [varṇādyaṃ kha-ga-gha-ṅa-śa |]vargādyaṃ bindumastakam | vāyubījaṃ ca tritayaṃ[cenduyutaṃ ka-gha-ṅa |] tritayaṃ [tryambaka- ka |]tryambakaṃ priye || 23 || [idaṃ kha-ga-gha |]imaṃ mantraṃ maheśāni prajapedauṣadhopari | pārade prajapenmantramaṣṭottaraśataṃ [priye ka |]yadi || 24 || [tadevauṣadhi- kha-ga |]tadevauṣadhayogena [bandho kha-ga |]baddho bhavati nānyathā || 25 || tataḥ [parasya ṅa |]parasmin divase śṛṇu matprāṇavallabhe | varayet [sarvva- śa |]karmmakarttāraṃ yathoktavibhavāvadhi || 26 || [suvarṇacampakā- kha-ga |]suvarṇaṃ campakākāraṃ karṇayugme [niveśayet śa |]nivedayet | [catuṣkoṇeṣu taṃ kha-ga |]catuṣkoṇayutaṃ svarṇaṃ grīvāyāṃ sumanoharam || 27 || hastadvaye maheśāni dadyād valayayugmakam | valayaṃ śuklavarṇañca aṅgarīyaṃ tathaiva ca || 28 || [tasmai kha-ga |]ūrmmiṃ dadyāt pītavastraṃ kṣaumavastrayugaṃ śive | [evaṃ kṛte kha-ga |]evaṃ kṛtvā maheśāni śivarūpaṃ vicintayet || 29 || --------------- 23 | vyomabījamityādi | tena haṃ kṣaṃ kaṃ yaṃ yaṃ yaṃ haṃ haṃ haṃ iti navākṣaro mantro bhavati |

pṛ0 55) navamaḥ paṭalaḥ |
[śrī nāsti ka-gha-pustakayoḥ |]śrīśiva uvāca- bhasmaprakāraṃ deveśi śṛṇu matprāṇavallabhe | karttāraṃ varayedādau yathoktavibhavāvadhi || 1 || [sauvarṇaṃ mauktikaṃ yuktaṃ kha-ga |]suvarṇaṃ mauktikayutaṃ karṇayugme nivedayet | hastayugme ca valayaṃ aṅgurīyaṃ tathaiva ca || 2 || tāḍadvayaṃ bāhuyugme śuddhakāñcananirmmitam | grīvāyāṃ dāpayet svarṇaṃ catuṣkoṇaṃ manoramam || 3 || vastrayugmaṃ [paṭṭasūtraṃ nirmi- ka-gha-ṅa |]paṭṭasūtranirmmitañca suśobhanam | [uṣṇīṣaṃ pītavastrañca parīdhānañca vāsasam kha-ga |]uṣṇīṣaṃ śuklavarṇañca [ūrmmiñca sitavāsasam gha, ūrmmī ca sītavāsasam ṅa |]uṣṇīṣaṃ pītavāsasam || 4 || evaṃ hi varayed devi karmmayogyaṃ [nivedayet kha-ga |]vicintayet | cintayecchivarūpañca cintayet triguṇātmakam || 5 || tataḥ parasmin divase śāntisvastyayanañcaret | nirmmitaṃ [śuddhavarṇena kha-ga-ṅa |]śuddhasvarṇena bilvapatreṇa sundari || 6 || sahasrasaṅkhyayā [japyaṃ kha-ga |]devi pārthivaṃ dvādaśaṃ yajet | ṣoḍaśenopacāreṇa paṭṭavastrayugena ca || 7 || [alaṅkāraṃ vici- ṅa |]alaṅkāravicitraiśca pūjayet [parameśvari kha-ga, parameśvarīm ka |]parameśvaram | bhogayogyaṃ [maheśāni gha-ṅa |]pradātavyaṃ madhuparkaṃ [śucismite kha-ga |]nivedayet || 8 ||
pṛ0 56) svarṇāsanena[ca -gha |] saṃsthāpya pratyekaṃ pūjanañcaret | pūjānte prajapenmantramaṣṭottaraśataṃ sudhīḥ || 9 || [-kṣaramahā- gha |]ṣaḍakṣaraṃ mahāmantraṃ [tataḥ prāsādasaṃjñakam ka-kha-ga-ṅa |]prāsādākhyaṃ manuṃ tataḥ | diksahastraṃ japenmantraṃ taddaśāṃśaṃ hunet priye || 10 || [homadravyaṃ hi gha |]homasya dravyaṃ deveśi śṛṇu matprāṇavallabhe | vālukānirmmite vāpi kuṇḍe vā parameśvari || 11 || dvātriṃśadaṅgulimānaṃ vistṛtaṃ tatsamaṃ priye | ṣoḍaśāṅgulimānaṃ hi [kaṇṭhaṃ ṅa |]kuṇḍaṃ kuryāt sulakṣaṇam || 12 || tadūrddhve parameśāni [vedanatrāṅguliṃ ga |]vedanetrāṅgaliṃ śive | evaṃ hi svarṇakumbhañca [tāmrakuṇḍāsamarthinā kha-ga, tāmrakumbhaṃ sama- ṅa |]tāmrakumbhāsamarthinā || 13 || etadanyataraṃ kumbhaṃ sthāpayed vedikopari | paṭṭavastreṇa yugmena saṃveṣṭya bahuyatnataḥ || 14 || homayed bilvapatreṇa [yathoktavidhinā śive kha-ga |]yathoktena sureśvari | [trimadhvoktena ka |]trimadhvaktena vidhinā tataḥ siddho bhaved dhruvam || 15 || tatastu dakṣiṇā kāryyā yathoktavibhavāvadhi | sarvvadravyamayaṃ[-samaṃ puṇyaṃ kha-ga |] mūlyaṃ dviguṇaṃ vā pradāpayet || 16 || [dakṣiṇāvihīno yajñaḥ siddhido na ca mokṣadaḥ kha-ga |]dakṣiṇāvihīnā[vihinā gha-ṅa |] yajñāḥ siddhidā na ca mokṣadāḥ | ata eva maheśāni dakṣiṇā vibhavāvadhi || 17 || ------------ 10 | ṣaḍakṣaramityādi | tena oṃ namaḥ śivāya hauṃ iti mantrasya daśasahasrajapataddaśāṃśahomādikaṃ karttavyamiti | 15 | trimadhvakteneti | madhutrayamuktaṃ varāhapurāṇe-kṣaudramikṣurasaṃ kṣīraṃ tathā trimadhuraṃ smṛtam | iti vaidikasarvasve |
pṛ0 57) varāhavatsamānīya janmamātre'pi sundari | pāradaṃ tolakaṃ mānaṃ bhakṣayed bahuyatnataḥ || 18 || punastolakamānaṃ hi mātṛdugdhaṃ tataḥ param | punaśca bhakṣayed dhīmāṃstato dugdhantu bhakṣayet || 19 || [tatastadvatsamānīya kha-ga |]tataśca vatsamānīya [sarvvadvāraṃ gha]navadvāraṃ prayatnataḥ | [gha-pustake padyārddhamidaṃ nāsti |]sūtrayogeṇa deveśi [bandhaṃ ka-kha-ga |]baddhaṃ kuryyāt prayatnataḥ || 20 || tataśca [tataścāhalakīmantra- kha-ga |]helakīmantramaṣṭottaraśataṃ japet | gajapramāṇaṃ deveśi [dīrghaputrantu ka |]dīrghaprasthantu khātakam || 21 || karīṣakeṇa deveśi [cūrṇaṃ ṅa |]pūrṇaṃ [kuryyāttu khātakam kha-ga |]kuryyādvicakṣaṇaḥ | tanmadhye sthāpayed vatsaṃ [sandahya ca prayatnataḥ kha-ga |]sandahed bahuyatnataḥ || 22 || vahnisthite maheśāni na spṛśet kuṇḍamuttamam | [kumbhe suśītale devi ka, kuṇḍeṣu śītale kha-ga, kuṇḍeṣu śīte jāte tu ṅa |]kuṇḍe suśītale jāta utthāpya bahuyatnataḥ || 23 || sarvvaprakāśakaṃ mantramaṣṭottaraśataṃ japet | viśveśvaraṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu pārvvati sādaram || 24 || pāradaṃ tolakaṃ mānaṃ tāmrapātre tu lepayet | cūrṇaṃ kuryānmaheśāni gandhakaṃ sārddhatolakam || 25 || samācchādya prayatnena cūrṇena parameśvari | sandahed bahuyatnena mandamandena vahninā || 26 ||
pṛ0 58) kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ [reṇuyuktaṃ kha-ga |]reṇuyutaṃ dṛṣṭvā utthāpya sundari | [ratipramāṇaṃ kha-ga, guñjāpramāṇaṃ gha |]rattipramāṇaṃ tad dravyaṃ bhakṣayed yadi sundari || 27 || satyaṃ satyaṃ [sarvāriṣṭaṃ kha-ga |]sarvvakuṣṭhaṃ bhakṣaṇānnāśamāpnuyāt | [amlapātra- gha |]anupānamuṣṇatoyaṃ matsyādīn parivarjayet || 28 || evaṃ prayogaṃ deveśi na kuryāt [sādhako gha-ṅa |]putravān gṛhī | prathame divase putrān [dvitīyadivase kha-ga-gha |]dvitīye divase dhanam || 29 || [tṛtīyadivase ga-gha-ṅa |]tṛtīye divase śaktiṃ [nāśayāmi na saṃśayaḥ kha-ga, caturthadivase gha |]caturthe divase gṛham | [caturthe divase rogaṃ pañcame śokamāpnuyāt kha-ga |]pañcame divase rogaṃ [nāśañca gha |]nāśaṃ tu jāyate dhruvam || 30 || ata eva maheśāni [śāntisvastyayanañca- kha-ga |]ātmasvastyayanañcaret | pūrvoktavidhinā mantrī [-rguṇamathācaret kha-ga |]caturguṇaṃ samācaret || 31 ||
iti śrīmātṛkābhedatantre [ayamaṃśo nāsti gha |]haragaurīsaṃvāde navamaḥ paṭalaḥ || 9 ||
pṛ0 59) daśamaḥ paṭalaḥ |
[ṅa-pustake śrī nāsti |]śrīdevyuvāca- [naraśceti gururnātha kha-ga |]narākṛtiṃ guruṃ nātha [mantravarṇā- ṅa |]mantraṃ varṇātmakaṃ tathā | [dhyānānurūpiṇīṃ deva ekaṃ vāpi kathaṃ vada gha |]dhyānānurūpiṇaṃ [deva ekatvaṃ vā kathaṃ bhavet kha-ga |]devamekatvaṃ vā kathaṃ vada || 1 || [śaṅkara kha-ga |]śrīśiva uvāca- guruvaktrānmahāmantro[-mantrī ka, -mantraṃ kha-ga |] [labhate kha-ga |]labhyate [-ttamaḥ kha-ga |]sādhakottamaiḥ | [yaddeyo jāyate bīja- kha-ga, yajñe vā jāyate vīrya- gha, yaddevājjāyate bījantasya prā |]yadyeko jāyate vīryyastasya [mukti- prā |]mūrttirbhaved dhruvam || 2 || devatāyāḥ śarīrañca[-ntu kha-ga, ...-raṃ hi gha-ṅa-prā |] bījādutpadyate priye | gurorājñānusāreṇa cānyamūrttistu jāyate || 3 || gurvādibhāvanād devi bhāvasiddhiḥ prajāyate | ata eva maheśāni caikatvaṃ parikathyate || 4 || --------------------- 4 | gurvādīti | atra saṃvādi pramāṇamuktaṃ yāmale- gururekaḥ śivaḥ proktaḥ so'haṃ devi na saṃśayaḥ | gurustvamapi deveśi mantro'pi gururucyate || ato mantre gurau deve na hi bhedaḥ prajāyate | kadācit sa sahasrāre padme dhyeyo guruḥ sadā || kadācidhṛdayāmbhoje kadāciddṛṣṭigocare || iti | muṇḍamālātantre ca- devatāgurumantrāṇāmaikyaṃ sambhāvayan dhiyā | tadā siddho bhavenmantraḥ prakaṭe hānireva ca || mantre vā gurudeve vā na bhedaṃ yastu kalpate | tasya tuṣṭā jagaddhātrī kiṃ na dadyād dine dine || iti |
pṛ0 60) [ṅa-pustake śrī nāsti |]śrīdevyuvāca- [yaccākṣaraṃ kha-ga |]yaccākṣuṣaṃ mahādeva tadākāraṃ vicintayat | [acakṣuṣo mahādeva kha-ga |]acākṣuṣe mahādeva dhyānaṃ[dhyānañca ṅa |] vā kīdṛśaṃ bhavet || 5 || śrīśiva uvāca- [-maye ṅa |]śabdabrahmamayaṃ devi mama [vaktrādi- ka |]vaktrādvinirgatam | ākārarahite devi yathā dhyānādikaṃ bhavet || 6 || tathaivoccāraṇenaiva bhaktiyuktena cetasā | satyaṃ satyaṃ maheśāni pratyakṣaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ || 7 || śrīdevyuvāca- paśupradāne vākyaṃ tu kīdṛśaṃ vada śaṅkara | yena vākyena [prāṇeśa gha-ṅa |]deveśa [kālī kha-ga |]devī tuṣṭā bhavatyapi || 8 || [kha-ga-pustakayoḥ śrī nāsti ka |]śrīśiva uvāca- mṛge mahiṣe coṣṭre ca paśuśabdaṃ na yojayet | chāgale ca tathā siṃhe vyāghre ca parameśvari || 9 || paśuśabdaṃ yojayitvā mahādevyai nivedayet | [bhāvastho yo ka-gha-ṅa |]paśubhāvasthito mantrī mahiṣo dīyate yadi || 10 || -------------- 9 | chāgale ceti | tathā ca chāgādibalidānaphalamuktaṃ muṇḍamālātantre- chāge datte bhavedvāgmī meṣe datte kavirbhavet | mahiṣe dhanavṛddhiḥ syānmṛge mokṣaphalaṃ labhet || pakṣidāne samṛddhiḥ syād godhikāyāṃ mahāphalam | nare datte maharddhiḥ syādaṣṭasiddhiranuttamā || iti | evaṃ tatraiva- rājā narabaliṃ dadyānnānyo hi parameśvari | siṃhavyāghranarān dattvā brāhmaṇo rauravaṃ vrajet || iti vacanād brāhmaṇānāṃ narādibalidāne nādhikāra iti | evamapi nibandhe tṛtīyapaṭale- siṃhaṃ vyāghraṃ narañcāpi svagātrarudhiraṃ tathā | madyañcāpi dadad vipro brāhmaṇyādeva hīyate || iti |
pṛ0 61) balidānaṃ [pravaktavyaṃ kha-ga |]prakarttavyaṃ na māṃsaṃ bhakṣayennaraḥ | samyak phalaṃ na labhate daśāṃśaṃ [labhyate ka-gha-ṅa |]labhate priye || 11 || mahiṣādi pradātavyaṃ divyavīramate sthitaḥ | sa eva siddhimāpnoti phalaṃ samyak priyaṃvade || 12 || paśudānaṃ vinā [devīṃ ha |]devi pūjayenna kadācana | tathā ca nityapūjāyāṃ yadi śakto bhavennaraḥ || 13 || kevalaṃ balidānena siddho bhavati nānyathā | [vidhinā ha |]nirdhanaḥ parameśāni yadi pūjādikañcaret || 14 || vatsarānte pradātavyaṃ balimekaṃ sureśvari | anyathā naiva siddhiḥ syādājanma pūjanādapi[dājanmāvadhi pūjanāt kha-ga |] || 15 || balidānaṃ mahāyajñaṃ kalikāle [tu kha-ga |]ca caṇḍike | aśvamedhādikaṃ yajñaṃ kalau nāsti [maheśvari kha-ga |]sureśvari || 16 || -------------- 13 | paśudānamityādi | atra saṃvādi pramāṇamuktaṃ kālītantre ekādaśapaṭale- na dadāti baliṃ yastu śivāyai śivatāptaye | sa pāpiṣṭho nādhikārī kuladevyāḥ samarccane || iti | tathā ca nibandhe tṛtīyapaṭale- balidānaṃ vinā yastu pūjayet tāriṇīṃ naraḥ | na jñānaṃ na ca mokṣaḥ syāt teṣāṃ paśudhiyāṃ priye || iti | atra tāriṇīttyupalakṣaṇam, yathā kālī tathā cchinnā yathā cchinnā tathonmukhī | yathā durgā tathā dhūmā tathā mahiṣamarddinī || yathā kālī tathā tārā sarvāstārāvibhedakāḥ | iti tasyaiva vacanāt | mahānīlatantrīyaṣaṣṭhapaṭalasya sundarī ca tathā cchinnā kālītārādikāśca yāḥ | mahāvidyāśca yāścānyāḥ sarvāstārāvadācaret || iti vacanācca | 16 | balidānamityādi | tatra ca strīpaśudānaniṣedha ukto mahānirvāṇatantrīyaṣaṣṭhollāse- balidānavidhau devi vihitaḥ puruṣaḥ paśuḥ | strīpaśurna ca hantavyastatra śāmbhavaśāsanāt || iti | anyatrāpi- śaktimāṃsaṃ na gṛhṇīyādaṇḍajaṃ jalajaṃ vineti haratattvadīdhitiḥ |
pṛ0 62) kevalaṃ balidānena [aśvamedha- kha-ga |]cāśvamedhaphalaṃ bhavet | yajñāvaśeṣaṃ yad dravyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ na cānyathā || 17 || yajñāvaśeṣabhogena sa [yajño kha-ga |]yajñī nātra saṃśayaḥ | [bhakṣayed gha |]na bhakṣed yadi mohena na yajñaphalabhāg bhavet || 18 || [tyajyaṃ kha-ga |]tyājyaṃ dravyaṃ kathaṃ devi [yato devyai kha-ga |]mahādevyai nivedayet | brahmarūpaṃ [mahāmantraṃ ka |]mahātantraṃ mama vaktrādvinirgatam || 19 || sa pūtaḥ sarvvapāpebhyo yadi caikākṣaraṃ śrutam | mahābhaktiyuto bhūtvā śṛṇoti [paṭhanaṃ kha-ga |]paṭalaṃ yadi || 20 || kiṃ tasya dhyānapūjāyāṃ tīrthasnānena tasya kim | śabdabrahmamayaṃ jñātvā samastaṃ yadi caṇḍike || 21 || kevalaṃ śravaṇenaiva [yat phalaṃ labhate naraḥ gha |]sa siddho nātra saṃśayaḥ | [gha-pustake padyārddhamidaṃ nāsti |]aṣṭādaśapurāṇānāṃ[purāṇāni ka-ṅa |] śravaṇenaiva yat phalam || 22 || caturvvedena [cāṅgena kha-ga |]sāṅgena [śravaṇe yat phalaṃ labhet kha-ga |]śravaṇenaiva yat phalam | [tasya tantrasya ka, asya mantrasya kha-ga |]asya tantrasya deveśi kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm || 23 || brahmarūpamidaṃ tantraṃ sārāt sāraṃ parāt param || 24 ||
iti śrīmātṛkābhedatantre[nāsti gha |] haragaurīsaṃvāde daśamaḥ paṭalaḥ || 10 ||
--------------- 17 | kevalamityādi | evamapi nibandhe pañcamapaṭale- sarvatrikoṭitīrtheṣu snātvā yat phalamaśnute | tat phalaṃ labhate bhaktyā balibhiḥ pūjanānmama || iti | bṛhannīlatantre ṣaṣṭhapaṭale'pi- bhūtahiṃsā na karttavyā paśuhiṃsā viśeṣataḥ | balidānaṃ vinā devyā hiṃsāṃ sarvatra varjayet || iti ||
pṛ0 63) ekādaśaḥ paṭalaḥ |

pṛ0 65) [padyārddhamidaṃ kha-ga-pustakayornāsti |]pūrṇāhutiṃ tato dattvā tato vākyaṃ samācaret | adyetyādi samuccāryya sauramāsaṃ samuccaret || 10 || tithigotraṃ cāmuko'haṃ dharmmārthakāmameva vā[ca kha-ga-gha-ṅa |] | prāptaye parameśāni tato mūlaṃ samuccaret || 11 || devatāyai namaḥ paścād dakṣiṇāṃ dāpayed gurau | kumbhatoyena deveśi snāpayed yajamānakam || 12 || [śāntyādīn sa kha-ga |]surāstvādīn samuccāryya śāntiṃ kuryyāt tato guruḥ | sarvvādau gurudevasya varaṇaṃ kārayet [budhaḥ kha-ga |]sudhīḥ || 13 || [suvarṇacampakākāraṃ kha-ga |]suvarṇaṃ campakākāraṃ karṇayugme nivedayet | catuṣkoṇayutaṃ svarṇaṃ grīvāyāṃ [paridhāpayet kha-ga |]pariyojayet || 14 || uṣṇīṣañca tato dadyāt [kaṇṭhamālāṃ ṅa |]kaṇṭhe mālāṃ [nidhāpayet kha-ga |]niyojayet | tāḍayugmaṃ tato bāhau valayaṃ maṇibandhake || 15 || aṅgulyāmaṅgurī[maṅgulīṃ deyaṃ ṅa |] deyā divyavastraṃ [nivedayet kha-ga |]niyojayet | evaṃ hi varaṇaṃ kṛtvā karmmayogyaṃ vicintayet || 16 || guruṃ vā guruputraṃ vā varayed yatnataḥ sudhīḥ | sadasyaṃ [ca prakarttavyaṃ kha-ga-ṅa |]na hi karttavyaṃ tantradhāraṃ [ca tatra vai kha-ga-ṅa |]na tatra vai || 17 || [ṅa-pustake padyārddhamidaṃ nāsti |]brahmāṇaṃ na hi karttavyaṃ kevalaṃ varayed gurum | [gurubhṛtyo kha-ga-ṅa |]gurorbhṛtyo maheśāni bhairavo nātra saṃśayaḥ || 18 ||
pṛ0 66) svīyena[snāṃyena ka |] paridhānena vāsasā toṣayet [gurum kha-ga |]svayam | svayaṃ hotā bhaved vipro gurorājñānusārataḥ || 19 || māyābījaṃ samuccārya ādhāraśaktaye namaḥ | anena manunā devi [devyāḥ saṃ- kha-ga |]vedisaṃskāramācaret || 20 || [bhūrasyetyādi- ka-gha, bhuvasvetyādi- kha-ga |]bhūrasītyādimantreṇa ghaṭa[yugme'bhi'- kha-ga |]-yugmābhimantritam | astrāntenaiva mūlena uṣṇīṣaṃ pariyojayet[-yojanaṃ ka |] || 21 || [vedoktaṃ naiva kha-ga |]vedoktañcaiva smṛtyuktaṃ [na mantraṃ kha-ga, mantraṃ nānāyajet gha |]mantraṃ na yojayet sudhīḥ | evaṃ [dhūpādi gha |]kūpādidāneṣu karttavyaṃ parameśvari || 22 || anyat sarvvaṃ samānaṃ hi prāsādādisthale punaḥ | kūpādiyojanaṃ kuryyāt [yaṣṭikāṣṭhavinirmmitam kha-ga |]yaṣṭiprotanamācaret || 23 || [evaṃ yaṣṭi prakartavyaṃ ka, ekayaṣṭiprakarttavyaṃ gha-ṅa |]caturhastapramāṇañca madhyabhāge[bhāgena potanam kha-ga, -bhāge tu potanam ṅa |] tu protanam | mūlamantraṃ samuccārya tato vahnibadhūṃ nyaset || 24 || tato yaṣṭiṃ samuccāryya [prota- ka-kha-ga-gha |]potayāmi vadet sudhīḥ | tatra santaraṇaṃ dhenuṃ naiva kuryyādvicakṣaṇaḥ || 25 || dhenusantaraṇenaiva phalahāniḥ prajāyate | [svarṇaraupyaṃ kha-ga-ṅa |]svarṇaṃ rūpyaṃ pravālañca dakṣiṇāṃ pariyojayet || 26 || snāpayitvā kumbhatoyaiḥ śāntiṃ kuryyāt tato guruḥ || 27 || -------------- 21 | bhūrasītyādi | mantrastu- oṃ bhūrasi bhūmirasyaditirasi viśvadhāyā viśvasya bhuvanasya dhartrī | pṛthivīṃ yaccha pṛthivīṃ dṛᳫhaḥ, pṛthivīṃ mā hiᳫsīḥ | śuklayajurvveda, 13|18
pṛ0 67) [anena vidhinā devi gha |]anenaiva vidhānena kūpādyutsargamācaret | [ṅa-pustake ślokārddhamidaṃ nāsti |]vāpīkūpataḍāgādi hyanenotsargamācaret || 28 || dīrghikāñca puṣkariṇīṃ [mūlenaiva gha |]hyanenaiva jalāśayam | [udakaṃ kha-ga |]utsṛjya parayā bhaktyā mahādevyai [nivedayet kha-ga |]prayatnataḥ || 29 || puruṣaṃ saptamaṃ kānte pitṛvaṃśe ca mātari | saptamaṃ puruṣaṃ [kāṇḍe kha-ga, kāntāraṃ setusamaṃ priye gha |]kānte mātṛvaṃśe samaṃ priye || 30 || kailāse nivasennityaṃ devyā varaprasādataḥ | svayaṃ devasvarūpaśca[-ñca ka |] jīvanmukto na saṃśayaḥ || 31 || aśvamedhasahasreṇa[-sahasrāṇi ṅa |] vājapeyaśatena[-śatāni ṅa |] ca | yat phalaṃ labhate devi tasmāllakṣaguṇaṃ bhavet || 32 || merutulyaṃ[-tulya- ka-gha-ṅa |]suvarṇantu[suvarṇañca gha-ṅa |] brāhmaṇe vedapārage | [dāne gha |]dattvā yat phalamāpnoti [tasya koṭi- kha-ga |]tasmāllakṣaguṇaṃ bhavet || 33 || [pūrṇamāśena ṅa |]pūrṇaśasyena deveśi saptadvīpāṃ vasundharām | pradadyād bahuyatnena brāhmaṇe vedapārage || [tasya koṭi- kha-ga |]tasmāllakṣaguṇaṃ puṇyamanena parameśvari || 34 || [padyamidaṃ ka-kha-ga-pustakeṣu nāsti |]sadakṣiṇaṃ vrataṃ sarvvaṃ dānaṃ yadvedasammatam | tasmāllakṣaguṇaṃ puṇyamanena parameśvari || 35 || [pārvatyuvāca kha-ga |]śrīcaṇḍikovāca- yajñasūtradhāraṇena[dhāraṇe tu kha-ga |] bhūpūjyo nātra saṃśayaḥ | idānīṃ yajñasūtrasya vidhānaṃ mayi kathyatām || 36 ||
pṛ0 68) [śiva ka-gha |]śrīśaṅkara uvāca- yajñasūtrasya yanmānaṃ tacchṛṇuṣva varānane | ṛgvedī dhārayet[-nnityaṃ ṅa |] sūtraṃ nābherūrddhvaṃ stanādadhaḥ || 37 || yajuṣāṃ sūtramānaṃ hi[paramāścaryyaṃ hi śailaje ga; hi paramāścaryyaśailaje gha; tu paramāścaryya śailaje kha-ṅa |] āścaryaṃ śailaje param | [bāhumūlaṃ ka |]bāhumūlapramāṇena yajñasūtraṃ dvijātibhiḥ | dhāraṇīyaṃ prayatnena [nānyadrūpaṃ kha-ga, nānyadaghnaṃ gha; nānyarūpaṃ ṅa |]nānyad dairghyaṃ kadācana || 38 || sāmagasya [dīrghasūtraṃ gha-ha0ta0 |]yajñasūtraṃ trividhaṃ [parameśvari kha-ga-ṅa |]varavarṇini | brahmarandhrānnābhideśaparyyantaṃ yajñasūtrakam || 39 || [śloko'yaṃ nāsti ha0ta0 |]athavāpi ca grīvāyāmāropya nābhi saṃspṛśet | tasmāt [pṛṣṭhe merudaṇḍa- kha-ga-gha-ṅa |]pṛṣṭhānmerudaṇḍaparyyantaṃ yajñasūtrakam || 40 || [athavetyādi yajuṣāṃ matamityanto bhāgaḥ kha-ga-gha-pustakeṣu nāsti |]athavā parameśāni prakārāntarakaṃ śṛṇu | grīvāyā dakṣiṇāṅguṣṭhaparyyantaṃ [parameśvari ṅa |]yajñasūtrakam || 41 || [padyārddhamidaṃ ṅa-pustake nāsti |]athavā dhārayet sūtraṃ yatnena yajuṣāṃ matam | athavā[atharvī kha-ga-ṅa |] dhārayet sūtraṃ sāmagasya pramāṇataḥ || 42 || -------------- 37 | yajñasūtrasyeti | yajñasūtraṃ kasya kiṃ nirmmitaṃ syādityapekṣāyāmuktaṃ mahānīlatantre ekatriṃśapaṭale,- kārpāsantu dvijātīnāṃ kṣaumañca bhūbhujāṃ tathā | vaiśyānāṃ śaṇasūtrañca śaṅkarasya matena ca || iti |

śrīśaṅkara uvāca- athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi pūjādhāraṃ sudurlabham | śālagrāme maṇau yantre pratimāyāṃ ghaṭe[jale ghaṭe kha-ga |] jale || 1 || pustikāyāñca gaṅgāyāṃ śivaliṅge prasūnake | śālagrāme śataguṇaṃ maṇau tadvat phalaṃ labhet[bhavet ṅa |] || 2 || yantre lakṣaguṇaṃ [proktaṃ kha-ga-ṅa |]puṇyaṃ mūrttau lakṣaṃ sulocane | [jale caikaguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ ghaṭe ṅa |]ghaṭe caikaguṇaṃ [proktaṃ kha-ga |]puṇyaṃ jale caikaguṇaṃ priye || 3 || pustikāyāṃ sahasrantu gaṅgāyāṃ tatsamaṃ phalam | śivaliṅge hyanantaṃ hi vinā pārthivaliṅgake[-liṅgakam prā0ha0ta0 |] || 4 || -------------------- 1 | athāta ityādi | atra saṃvādi guptasādhanatantrāṣṭamapaṭalavacanamullikhyate- athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi pūjādhārantu siddhidam | yaṃ vinā parameśāni na hi siddhiḥ prajāyate | śālagrāme maṇau yantre pratimāyāṃ sureśvari | pustikāyāñca gaṅgāyāṃ sāmānyena jale tathā || athavā puṣpayantreṇa pūjayecchivaliṅgake | yantrabhedena deveśi phalaṃ samyak prajāyate || śālagrāme śataguṇaṃ maṇau tadvat phalaṃ labhet | yantre lakṣaguṇaṃ proktaṃ pratimāyāṃ tathaiva ca || pustikāyāñca gaṅgāyāṃ samānaphalamīritam || iti | 4 | śivaliṅga ityādi | atrāpi guptasādhanapramāṇam- śivaliṅge maheśāni anantaphalamīritam | na kuryyāt pārthive liṅge devīpūjādikāḥ kriyāḥ || pārthive pūjanād devi siddhihāniḥ prajāyate | yadi daivānmaheśāni mṛttikāskhalanaṃ bhavet || tāvad varṣasahasrāṇi narake pūyaśoṇite | kumbhīpāke mahāghore pacyate pitṛbhiḥ saha || ata eva maheśāni pārthive na hi pūjayet | sphaṭikādīn samānīya liṅgaṃ nirmmāya yatnataḥ || talliṅge pūjanād devi sarvvasiddhiyuto bhavet || iti | evamapi pārthive devatāviśeṣa-
pṛ0 71) puṣpayantre maheśāni pūjanāt sarvvasiddhibhāk | śālagrāme ca pūjāyāṃ na likhed yantramuttamam || 5 || [padyārddhamidaṃ kha-ga-ṅa-pustakeṣu nāsti |]maṇau sthite maheśāni na likhed yantramuttamam | pratimāyāñca pūjāyāṃ na likhed yantramuttamam || 6 || pratimāyāśca[-ñca ka |] purato ghaṭaṃ [sthāpya prayatnataḥ kha-ga |]saṃsthāpya yatnataḥ | parivārān yajet tatra ghaṭe tu parameśvari || 7 || [mantrādhiṣṭhitadevāṃśca ghaṭavaktre ca kha-ga, yantrādhiṣṭhitadevānāṃ ṅa |]yantrādhiṣṭhātṛdevāṃśca [ghaṭavaktre kha-ga-gha-prā0, ha0ta0 ghaṭe vaktre ṅa |]ghaṭe yantre prapūjayet | samastadevatārūpaṃ [ghaṭañca kha-ga-gha-ṅa-prā0 |]ghaṭantu paricintayet | [mūladruma- ṅa |]suradrumasvarūpo'yaṃ[-svarūpo hi prā0 |] ghaṭo[ghaṭo'yaṃ ka-gha-ṅa-prā0 |] hi parameśvari || 8 || [mahāyantrantu deveśi kha-ga |]janmasthānaṃ mahāyantraṃ yadi [kuryyācca kha-ga |]kuryyāt tu sādhakaḥ | [padyārddhamidaṃ gha-pustake nāsti |]tatra mūrttiṃ na [kuryyācca kha-ga |]kuryyāt tu [yadi yantrañca kārayet prā0 |]kadācidapi mohataḥ || 9 || [yatra mūrttiḥ kṛtā devi gha, idamarddhaṃ nāsti prā0 |]yadi mūrttiṃ prakuryyāt tu tatra yantraṃ na kārayet | yadi kuryyāt tu mohena yajed vāradvayaṃ priye || 10 || dviguṇaṃ pūjanaṃ tatra dviguṇaṃ balidānakam | dviguṇaṃ prajapenmantraṃ dviguṇaṃ [homamācaret gha-prā0 |]homayet sudhīḥ || 11 || ------------ pūjane phalaviśeṣamuktaṃ tantrāntaratantre- kālikāṃ tāriṇīñcaiva tripurāṃ bhuvaneśvarīm | yo'rccayet pārthive liṅge sa yāti paramāṃ gatim || tāriṇyāḥ kālikāyāśca sundaryyāḥ parameśvari | pārthive pūjanād devi caturvargaphalaṃ labhet || iti | atra ca sāmānyaviśeṣanyāyena vidhiniṣedhayoravirodhaṃ pramāṇayanto'nūcānā vaṃśaparamparayā tathaiva vyavaharantīti |
