śrīcaṇḍikovāca- śṛṇu nātha parānanda parāparajagatpate | idānīṃ śrotumicchāmi mālāyāḥ[-yāṃ ṅa |] kīdṛśo japaḥ | [kiṃ mānaṃ ka-gha-ṅa |]kā mālā kasya devasya tad vadasva samāhitaḥ || 1 || śrīśaṅkara uvāca- vaiṣṇave tulasīmālā gajadantairgaṇeśvare | kālikāyā [mahāmantro japeddantākhya- ka |]mahāmantraṃ japed rudrākṣamālayā || 2 || tārāyāśca japenmantrī mahāśaṅkhākhyamālayā | mahāśaṅkhākhyamālāyāṃ sarvvāṃ vidyāṃ japet sudhīḥ || 3 || -------------- 2 | vaiṣṇava ityādi | atra pramāṇam- suvarṇamaṇibhirmālāṃ sphāṭikīṃ śaṅkhanirmitām | pravālaireva vā kuryyāt putrajīvaṃ vivarjjayet || padmākṣañcaiva rudrākṣaṃ bhadrākṣañca viśeṣataḥ | raktacandanamālā tu bhogadā mokṣadā bhavet || vaiṣṇave tulasīmālā gajadantairgaṇeśvare | tripurāyā jape śastā rudrākṣai raktacandanaiḥ | iti muṇḍamālātantroktaṃ saṃvadatyatra | tatrāpi maṇisaṃkhyāmāha yoginītantre- maṇisaṃkhyāṃ mahādevi mālāyāḥ kathayāmi te | pañcaviṃśatibhirmokṣaṃ puṣṭyai tu saptaviṃśatiḥ || triṃśadbhirdhanasiddhiḥ syāt pañcāśanmantrasiddhaye | aṣṭottaraśataiḥ sarvasiddhireva maheśvari || ......dantamālā jape kāryyā gale dhāryyā nṛṇāṃ śubhā | daśanairyadi karttavyā saṃkhyā dantasya te priye || iti | 3 | tārāyā ityādi | atra saṃvādi pramāṇaṃ muṇḍamālāyām- mahāśaṅkhamayī mālā nīlasārasvate vidhau | iti | tārākalpe'pi- acirād vihitā siddhirmahāśaṅkhākhyamālayā | mahāśaṅkhamayī mālā jñeyā tārāmanau priye || iti ca | uktañca nityātantre prathamapaṭale- samāśritya mahāśaṅkhamālāṃ vīrapadaṃ vrajet | iti |
pṛ0 82) akasmād vai mahāsiddhirmahāśaṅkhākhyamālayā | tathaiva [sakalāṃ vidyāṃ ka-gha-ṅa |]sakalā vidyā mahāśaṅkhe vaset [priye ṅa |]sadā || 4 || [sphāṭikīṃ ka-gha-ṅa |]sphāṭikī sarvvadevasya [purāṇaiḥ gha |]pravālaiḥ sakalāṃ japet | svarṇaraupyasamudbhūtāṃ[-bhūtaṃ ka-gha-ṅa |] sarvvadeveṣu yojitām[-tam gha-ṅa |] || 5 || kālikāyāśca sundaryyā [rudrākṣe kha-ga |]rudrākṣaiḥ prajapet sadā | bhairavyāḥ prajapenmantrī[-nmantraṃ ṅa |] śaṅkhapadmākhyayā[-khyayoḥ kha-ga |] priye || 6 || [śmaśānadhusturai- kha-ga, śmaśānadhusturabhavāṃ ṅa |]śmaśāne dhusturairmālāṃ japed dhūmāvatīvidhau | iti te kathitaṃ kānte mahāmālāvinirṇayam[-rṇayaḥ kha-ga |] || 7 || atha granthiṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu kānte samāhitā[-hitaḥ ka |] || yena mālā susiddhā ca [sarvepsitaphalapradā ṅa |]nṛṇāṃ sarvvaphalapradā || 8 || ----------- ata eva maheśāni asthimālā gale mama | iti ca | yoginītantre dvitīyapaṭale'pi- varṇamālā śubhā proktā sarvamantrapradīpanī | tasyāḥ pratinidhirdevi mahāśaṅkhamayī śubhā | mahāśaṅkhaḥ kare tasya siddhiradūrataḥ | tadabhāve vīravandye sphāṭikī sarvvasiddhidā || iti | 4 | akasmādityādi | atra ca saṃvādi pramāṇamuktaṃ guptasādhanatantre ekādaśapaṭale- mahāśaṅkhākhyamālāyāṃ yo japet sādhakottamaḥ | aṇimādivibhūtīnāmīśvaro nātra saṃśayaḥ || ......yadi bhāgyavaśād devi mahāśaṅkhañca labhyate | sa siddhaḥ sa gaṇaḥ so'pi sa ca viṣṇurna saṃśayaḥ || tadaiva sahasā siddhirnātra kāryyā vicāraṇā || iti | 7 | śmaśāna ityādi | atra saṃvādi pramāṇamuktaṃ muṇḍamālātantre- śmaśānadhusturairmālā jñeyā dhūmāvatīvidhau | iti | 8 | atha granthimityādi | granthau sūtrādiniyamamapyāha sanatkumāratantre- kārpāsasambhavaṃ sūtraṃ dharmmakāmārthamokṣadam | tacca viprendrakanyābhirnirmmitañca suśobhanam || śvetaṃ raktaṃ tathā kṛṣṇaṃ paṭṭasūtramathāpi vā | śāntivaśyābhicāreṣu mokṣaiśvaryyajayeṣu ca || śuklaṃ raktaṃ tathā pītaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ varṇeṣu ca kramāt | sarvveṣāmeva varṇānāṃ raktaṃ sarvvepsitipradam ||
pṛ0 83) mālāyāścādhikā[-ścādhikāṃ ka |] kānte [granthicaikāṃ ka |]granthiścaikā phalapradā | ekapañcāśikāyāñca mālāyāṃ parameśvari || 9 || [-granthiyutāṃ mātāṃ sā- ga, granthiṃ yugmavāṇasārddhatri- ka-gha-ṅa |]brahmagranthiyutāṃ mālāṃ sārddhadvitayaveṣṭitām[-veṣṭitī ṅa |] | sapādaveṣṭanaṃ devi nāgapāśaṃ manoharam || 10 || sarvvadevasya mālāyāṃ sarvvatra parameśvari | brahmagranthiṃ vidhāyetthaṃ nāgapāśamathāpi vā || 11 || [mālāyāmadhikāṃ kha-ga, mālāyāścādhikāṃ ṅa |]mālāyāṃ tvadhikāṃ devi caikāṃ granthiṃ pradāpayet | mūlena [grathanaṃ kha-ga |]grathitaṃ kuryāt praṇavenāthavā priye || 12 || ------------------ triguṇaṃ triguṇīkṛtya grathayecchilpaśāstrataḥ | ekaikaṃ mātṛkāvarṇaṃ satāraṃ prajapan sudhīḥ || mālāmādāya sūtreṇa grathayenmadhyamadhyataḥ | brahmagranthiṃ vidhāyetthaṃ meruñca granthisaṃyutam || grathayitvā puro mālāṃ tataḥ saṃskāramārabhet || ekavīrākalpe ca- mātṛkāvarṇato granthiṃ vidyayā vātha kārayet | suvarṇādiguṇairvāpi grathayet sādhakottamaḥ || iti | granthiniyamaśca ekavīrākalpe- brahmagranthiṃ tato dadyānnāgapāśamathāpi vā | iti | chandaḥsāre'pi- trirāvṛttigranthikena tathārdhena vidhīyate | sārddhadvayāvarttanena granthiṃ kuryyād yathā dṛḍham || kālikāpurāṇe ca- brahmagranthiyutaṃ kuryyāt pratibījaṃ yathāsthitam | athavā granthirahitaṃ dṛḍharajjusamanvitam || evaṃ nirmāya mālāṃ vai śodhayenmunisattama || iti | 9 | mālāyā ityādi | mālā kīdṛśī karttavyā ityapekṣāyāmuktaṃ guptasādhanatantre ekādaśapaṭale- gopucchasadṛśīṃ kuryyādathavā sarparūpiṇīm | sthūlā sūkṣmā ca paryyantaṃ krameṇa grathanañcaret || mūlena grathanaṃ kāryyaṃ praṇavenāthavā priye | brahmagranthiṃ prayatnena dadyāt sādhakasattamaḥ || sūtradvayaṃ pareśāni militaṃ kārayet tataḥ | meruñca grathanaṃ kāryyaṃ tadūrddhve granthisaṃyutam || samīpe gurudevasya saṃskāramācaret sudhīḥ | sthūlāvadhi japenmantraṃ sūkṣmabhāge samāpayet || pucchāvadhi japād devi siddhihāniḥ prajāyate || iti |
pṛ0 84) [granthiṃ madhye ka-gha-ṅa |]granthimadhye [tu ṅa |]ca guṭikāṃ [kuryyāddanti- ṅa |]kuryyādatimanoharām[-manoramam ka-gha- |] | sūtradvayaṃ maheśāni [mīlanaṃ kha-ga |]milanaṃ kārayet tataḥ || 13 || meruñca grathanaṃ kuryāt tadūrddhve granthisaṃyutam | evaṃ mālāṃ vinirmāya gopayed bahuyatnataḥ || 14 || kampanaṃ dhūnanaṃ śabdaṃ [naivaṃ kha-ga |]naiva tatra prakāśayet | karabhraṣṭaṃ tathā chinnaṃ mahāvighnasya kāraṇam || 15 || kampane siddhihāniḥ syād dhūnanaṃ bahuduḥkhadam | śabde jāte [bhavedrogaṃ kha-ga |]bhavedrogaḥ [karabhraṣṭādi- ka |]karabhraṣṭādvināśakṛt || 16 || [chinne sūtre kha-ga |]chinnasūtre bhavenmṛtyustasmād yatnaparo bhavet | evaṃ jñātvā maheśāni śāntisvastyayanaṃ caret || 17 || -------------- 14 | meruñcetyādi | atra saṃvādi pramāṇam ekavīrākalpe- kavacenātha badhnīyānmālāṃ dhyānaparāyaṇaḥ | sarvvaśeṣaṃ tato meruṃ sūtradvayasamanvitam || grathayet tārayogeṇa badhnīyāt sādhakottamaḥ | iti | gautamīye ca- mukhe mukhañca saṃyojya pucche pucchañca yojayet | gopucchasadṛśī mālā yadvā sarpākṛtirbhavet || mukhapucchaniyamaśca chandaḥsāre- rudrākṣasyonnataṃ proktaṃ mukhaṃ pucchantu nimnagam | kamalākṣasya sūkṣmāṃśaṃ sabindudvitayaṃ mukham || sabindukasya sthūlāṃśaṃ pucchaṃ ślakṣṇamiti sthitam | evaṃ jñātvā mukhaṃ pucchaṃ rudrākṣāmbhoruhākṣayoḥ | tatsajātīyamekākṣaṃ merutvenāgrato nyaset | ekaikaṃ maṇimādāya brahmagranthiṃ prakalpayet || ekaikaṃ mātṛkāvarṇaṃ grathanādau tu saṃjapet || iti | 15 | kampanamityādi | atra saṃvādi pramāṇantu mālāśodhanamadhikṛtyoktaṃ yoginīhṛdaye- homakarma tataḥ kuryyād devatābhāvasiddhaye | aṣṭottaraśataṃ hutvā sampātājyaṃ vinikṣipet || homakarmaṇyaśaktaśced dviguṇaṃ japamācaret | nānyamantraṃ japenmantrī kampayenna vidhūnayet || kampanāt siddhihāniḥ syād dhūnanaṃ bahuduḥkhadam | śabde jāte bhavedrogaḥ karabhraṣṭā vināśakṛt || chinne sūtre bhavenmṛtyustasmād yatnaparo bhavet | japānte karṇadeśe vā uccadeśe'thavā nyaset || iti | kampanaṃ japakattuḥ śarīrasya, dhūnanaṃ mālāyā iti kecid vyācakṣate |
pṛ0 85) kampane yo japenmantraṃ yadi siddhiṃ prayacchati | yatnena gurumānīya [dvātriṃśadupa- kha-ga-ṅa |]dvāviṃśadupacārataḥ || 18 || kumbhasthāpanakaṃ kṛtvā pūjayediṣṭadevatām | tato huned bilvapatrairaṣṭottaraśatāhutim || 19 || [trimadhvoktena ka |]trimadhvaktena vidhinā dhūnane'pi ca sundari | saśabde [jalpamāne ca kha-ga |]japane caṇḍi hyevaṃ kuryād vicakṣaṇaḥ || 20 || karabhraṣṭe tathā chinne puraścaraṇamācaret | japādyante yajed devīṃ ṣoḍaśairupacārakaiḥ || 21 || ------------ 21 | karabhraṣṭa ityādi | atra- jīrṇe sūtre punaḥ sūtraṃ grathayitvā śataṃ japet | pramādāt patitā hastācchatamaṣṭottaraṃ japet || japenniṣiddhasaṃsarge kṣālayitvā yathoditam | iti vaiśampāyanasaṃhitoktapramāṇam | chinne sūtre punaḥ sūtraṃ grathayitvā śataṃ japet | iti kubjikātantroktapramāṇañcopajīvya yaduktaṃ tantrasārakṛtā chinne'pi aṣṭottaraśatajapaḥ kāryyaḥ, karabhraṣṭacchinnayostulyatvāditi, tattu granthametamanālocyaiveti sudhībhiścintanīyam | puraścaraṇamiti |- puraścaraṇavidhiścoktastantrasāre- kulārṇave ...evaṃ japaṃ purā kṛtvā gandhākṣatakuśodakaiḥ | japaṃ samarpayed devyā vāmahaste vicakṣaṇaḥ || japānte pratyahaṃ mantrī homayet taddaśāṃśataḥ | tarpaṇañcābhiṣekañca tattaddaśāṃśato mune || prattyahaṃ bhojayed viprān nyūnādhikapraśāntaye || tathā homādyaśaktau ca yoginīhṛdaye-homakarmmaṇyaśaktānāṃ viprāṇāṃ dviguṇo japaḥ | ityādinā | gandharvvatantre'ṣṭāviṃśatipaṭale ca- ...japasaṃkhyādaśāṃśataḥ | yathoktavihite kuṇḍe juhuyāt saṃskṛte'nale || athavā pratyahaṃ japtvā juhuyāt taddaśāṃśataḥ | tathā homadaśāṃśantu jale sampūjya devatām || tarpayāmīti mantrānte proktābhirmūrddhni tarpayet | japo homastarpaṇañca pūjā brāhmaṇabhojanam || pūrvvapūrvvadaśāṃśena kuryyāt pañcāṅgasaṃyutam | svābhiṣekāghamarṣau ca sūryyārghyaṃ jalapānakam || prāṇāyāmaṃ tataḥ kuryyāt pūrvvapūrvvadaśāṃśataḥ | daśāṅgopāsanaṃ bhaktyā puraścaraṇamucyate || tat puraścaraṇaṃ nāma mantrasiddhyarthamātmanaḥ | yathoktaṃ niyamaṃ kṛtvā svakalpoktajapasya ca || karaṇaṃ vijayāntaṃ tat proktaṃ deśikasattamaiḥ | tadante mahatīṃ
pṛ0 86) pratyahaṃ prajapenmantraṃ pratyahaṃ balidānakam | pañcāṅgasya pramāṇena sarvakarmma samāpayet || 22 || daridraḥ parameśāni yadi vighnaparāyaṇaḥ | ādyante mahatīṃ pūjāṃ [kuryyāt sādhakasattamaḥ ṅa |]diksahasraṃ japenmanum || 23 || sahasraikaṃ hunet paścāt [sarvavighnopaśāntaye kha-ga |]sarvavighnasya śāntaye | kumbhatoyaiḥ snāpayitvā punarmālāṃ pradāpayet || 24 || [hyane- ka-gha |]anenaiva vidhānena vighnajālairna lipyate || 25 ||
iti śrīmātṛkābhedatantre haragaurīsaṃvāde [caturdaśaḥ kha-ga |]trayodaśaḥ paṭalaḥ || 13 ||
------------ pūjāṃ kuryyād brāhmaṇabhojanam | guruṃ santoṣayedevaṃ mantrāḥ siddhyanti mantriṇaḥ | homakarmmaṇyaśaktānāṃ viprāṇāṃ dviguṇo japaḥ || iti | 23 | diksahasramiti-daśasahasramityarthaḥ | 24 | sahasraikamiti | atrāpi homādyaśaktau homasaṃkhyādviguṇajapādikaṃ karttavyamiti bodhyam |
pṛ0 87) caturddaśaḥ paṭalaḥ |
śrīcaṇḍikovāca- mantradhāraṇamātreṇa tatkṣaṇe[-kṣaṇāt kha-ga |] tanmayo bhavet | jīvātmā kuṇḍalīmadhye pradīpakalikā yathā || 1 || nijeṣṭadevatārūpā dehasaṃsthā ca kuṇḍalī | bhujyate saiva dehasthā kā cintā sādhakasya ca | tanme brūhi mahādeva yadyahaṃ tava vallabhā || 2 || [ka-pustake śrī nāsti |]śrīśaṅkara uvāca- [bhogantu trividhaṃ ka |]bhogastu trividho devi divyavīrapaśukramāt | nirlipto divyabhāvasthaḥ kuṇḍalī bhujyate [yadā ṅa |]yadi || 3 || ājihvāntā kuṇḍalinī vīrasya vīravandite[-vallabhe ṅa |] | mahādevyāḥ prītaye ca prasādaṃ bhujyate paśuḥ || 4 || dvijāterdivyabhāvaśca[-bhāveśa ka |] sadā nirvāṇadāyakaḥ | vipro vīraśca nirvāṇī bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ || 5 || sāyujyādi mahāmokṣaṃ niyuktaṃ kṣatriyādiṣu | paśunā bhaktiyuktena prasādaṃ bhujyate yadi || 6 || svargabhogī[-bhāgī ṅa |] bhavatyeva maraṇe nādhikāritā | janmāntaramavāpnoti mahādevyāḥ prasādataḥ || 7 || ------------ 3 | bhogastvityādi | rudrayāmale ṣaṣṭhapaṭale bhāvatrayamuktamanulomakrameṇa, yathā- ādau bhāvaṃ paśoḥ kṛtvā paścāt kuryyādavaśyakam | vīrabhāvaṃ mahābhāvaṃ sarvvabhāvottamottamam || tatpaścādatisaundaryyaṃ divyabhāvaṃ mahāphalam | kuryyād bhāvatrayaṃ divyaṃ bhāvasādhanamuttamam || iti | atra ca bhāvasya prātilomyena kathane'pi kramaśabdopādānaṃ bhogasya kramāpakarṣajñāpanārtham | tathāca divyabhāve sarvvotkarṣeṇa bhogaḥ, tataḥ krameṇa tasya hrāsa iti sudhībhirvvivecyam ||
pṛ0 88) divyavīramate dṛṣṭirjāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ | divyavīraprasādena nirvāṇī nātra saṃśayaḥ || 8 || prasādabhogī yo devi sa paśurnātra saṃśayaḥ | maraṇe nādhikāro'sti paśubhāvasthitasya ca || 9 || naiva muktirbhavet tasya janma [nāpnoti ka |]cāpnoti niścitam || 10 || śrīcaṇḍikovāca- vada me parameśāna divyavīrasya [sammatam kha-ga |]lakṣaṇam | yat kṛte divyavīrasya mahāmuktirbhaviṣyati || 11 || śrīśaṅkara uvāca- sākṣād brahmamayī devī cābhiśaptā ca vāruṇī | śāpamocanamātreṇa [brahmarūpadharā kha-ga |]brahmarūpā sudhā parā || 12 || nivedanānmahādevyai tattad devī bhavet kila | mūlādhārāt kuṇḍalinīmājihvāntāṃ [hi bhāvayet kha-ga |]vibhāvayet || 13 || -------------- 8 | divyavīretyādi | divyasya vīrasya ca lakṣaṇamuktaṃ kāmākhyātantre caturthapaṭale- divyaḥ sarvvamanohārī mitavādī sthirāsanaḥ | gabhīraḥ śliṣṭavaktā ca śatāvadhānakaḥ sukhī || gurupādāmbuje bhīruḥ sarvvatra bhayavarjjitaḥ | sarvvadarśī sarvvavaktā sarvvaduṣṭanivārakaḥ || sarvvaguṇānvito divyaḥ so'haṃ kiṃ bahuvākyataḥ || iti | nirbhayo bhayado vīro gurubhaktiparāyaṇaḥ | vācālo balavāñchuddhaḥ pañcatattve sadā ratiḥ || mahotsāho mahābuddhirmahāsāhasiko'pi ca | mahāśayaḥ sadā devi sādhūnāṃ pālane rataḥ || tamomayaḥ sadā vīro vinayena mahotsukaḥ | evaṃ bahuguṇairyukto vīro rudraḥ svayaṃ priye || iti ca | 9| prasādetyādi | atra saṃvādi pramāṇamuktaṃ kāmākhyātantre caturthapaṭale- ya uktaḥ paśubhāvo hi kalau kastasya pālakaḥ | pañcatattvaṃ na gṛhṇāti tatra nindāṃ karoti na || śivena gaditaṃ yattu tat satyamiti bhāvayan | ......yadi caṃkramaṇe śaktaḥ khaḍagadhāre sadā naraḥ | paśvācāraṃ sadā kuryyāt kintu siddhirna jāyate || ityādi |
pṛ0 89) tanmukhe dānamātreṇa [sādhako jñānavān ṅa |]jñānavān sādhako bhavet | yathaiva kuṇḍalī devī dehamadhye vyavasthitā || 14 || tathaiva [cābalāṃ kha-ga |]vāruṇīṃ dhyāyet [kalāddheṃ kha-ga, sakalāṅge ka |]kalāṅge sveṣṭadevatām | kuṇḍalyā [madhyabhāge tu ṅa |]samabhāvena śaktivaktre pradāpayet || 15 || [ātmotsṛṣṭaṃ kha-ga |]ātmocchiṣṭaṃ mahāpūtaṃ tanmukhāt paramāmṛtam | avaśyameva gṛhṇīyāt [tadātmānaṃ kha-ga, tadvaktrena ṅa |]tādātmyena varānane || 16 || utsṛṣṭādivicāro'pi kadācinnāsti brahmaṇi | gaṅgātoyaṃ paraṃ brahma prasādaṃ [kasyacid vada ṅa |]kasya tad vada || 17 || gaṅgāsāgaratoyaṃ vā prasādaṃ kasya vā bhavet | śṛṇu [jāye mahāmāye kha-ga |]devi pravakṣyāmi tajjale snānamātrataḥ || 18 || muktibhāgī bhavenmartyaḥ[-rttyastajjale cāvagāhanāt kha-ga, -rttyojale snānāvagāhanāt ṅa |] snānāvagāhanāt kila | [padādi- kha-ga |]pādādimastakāntaṃ vai snānakāle pramajjati || 19 || pādasparśo[-sparśe na doṣāya kha-ga |] na doṣāya paraṃbrahmaṇi śailaje | paramātmani līne ca tathaiva parameśvari || 20 || ----------------- 15 | śaktivaktre iti | atra viśeṣastu niruttaratantre pañcamapaṭale- nijaśaktiṃ vinā devi śaktyucchiṣṭaṃ pibed yadi | raurave narake ghore yāvadindrāścaturddaśa || ekāsane vased yastu bhuñjīta caikabhājane | parasparamukhasparśe sa yāti narakaṃ dhruvam || ekāsanastho yo vīro divyo vā kulasundari || sudhāṃ pītvā vīracakre rauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajet || mahāsiddhīśvaro vāpi bhuṅkte pītvā parasparam | siddhihāniṃ puraskṛtya sa yāti narakaṃ dhruvam || vinā śaktiṃ pibed dravyaṃ vīro guruparāyaṇaḥ | tathāpi narake ghore patatyeva na saṃśayaḥ | śaktyabhāve kuleśāni tad dravyaṃ jalataḥ kṣipet | gurvabhāve ca tad dravyaṃ jalato vinivedayet | iti ||
pṛ0 90) iti te kathitaṃ [kānte kha-ga |]devi divyavīrasya lakṣaṇam | [yoni- kha-ga, vīratantre'pi ṅa |]vīratantre ca kathitaṃ māhātmyaṃ prāṇavallabhe || 21 || śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi [vīrikāyāśca kha-ga |]sādhikāyāśca lakṣaṇam | divyaśaktirvīraśaktirguruśaktistathā parā || 22 || kulaśaktiḥ kāminī ca navaśaktiḥ kumārikā | śrīguruṃ pūjayed bhaktyā svadehadānapūrvvakam || 23 || anyathā [tasya dehasya kha-ga |]tu svadehasya nigraho jāyate dhruvam || saptajanmani sā devī [puṃścalī jāyate dhruvam ṅa |]pukkasī pativarjjitā || 24 [atraiva ṅa-pustake caturdaśaḥ paṭalaḥ samāpto jāta iti ||]|| śivaṃ [natvā kha-ga |]matvā svakāntañca pūjāsādhanamācaret | kadācinna yajeccānyaṃ puruṣaṃ parameśvari || 25 || anyasya yajanāccaṇḍi sarvanāśo bhaved dhruvam | [kāntasyāyuktahīnatvaṃ ka |]kāntasyāyurvihīnatvaṃ [putrāṇāṃ nāśamāpnuyāt kha-ga-kaṭīppanī |]vipattiñca pade pade || 26 || dhananāśo bhavennityaṃ devyāḥ [krodheśa ka |]krodhaśca jāyate | avaśyaṃ pūjayennityaṃ gurudevaṃ sanātanam || 27 || bhadrābhadravicārañca[vicāro'pi ka |] yā karoti gurusthale | tasyā mantraṃ krodhayuktaṃ [-ttiñca ka |]vipattiśca pade pade || 28 || varaṃ janamukhānnindā varaṃ prāṇān parityajet | tathāpi [pūjayeccaivaṃ kha-ga |]pūjayed devaṃ sākṣānnirvāṇadāyakam || 29 ||
pṛ0 91) sadā bhayañca[bhaktiñca kha-ga |] kāpaṭyaṃ varjayed gurupūjane || 30 || śrīgurostejasaṃ bhaktyā yadi dhāraṇamācaret | satyaṃ satyaṃ [maheśāni ka |]punaḥ satyaṃ kāśī sā nātra saṃśayaḥ || 31 || abhaktyā parameśāni yadi dhāraṇamācaret | japapūjādikaṃ [tasya varddhate tejasādhikam kha-ga |]tasyāḥ sandahet tena tejasā || 32 || śrīcaṇḍikovāca- sapatnīkaṃ yajed devaṃ guruṃ nirvāṇadāyakam | [tasyāḥ kha-ga |]tasya saṅgaṃ parityajya kathamātmaniyojanam || 33 || śrīśaṅkara uvāca- śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi gurorājñānusārataḥ | dhārayet tejasaṃ bhaktyā svayaṃ lipsāvivarjjitā || 34 || gurupatnyāścātmajaśca śrīguro[-rātmayoṣitaḥ kha-ga |]rātmajo yataḥ | gurupatnī guruḥ sākṣād guruputro na saṃśayaḥ || 35 || ekasya pūjanāt kānta ubhayoḥ pūjanaṃ bhavet | guruputro gaṇeśaśca guruputraḥ ṣaḍānanaḥ || 36 || ekaṃ gurusutaṃ kānte pūjane yā sadā ratā | anyaṃ gurusutaṃ kānte pūjayenna kadācana || 37 || vīraṃ vā divyamūrttiṃ vā kadācinna hi [pūjanāt kha-ga |]pūjayet | ekasya pūjanād devi mahāsiddhīśvaro bhavet || 38 || ubhayostrīṇi catvāri yā nārī pūjanañcaret | tasyāḥ samastaṃ viphalaṃ dhyānādi-japa-pūjanam || 39 ||
pṛ0 92) yadi bhāgyavaśād devi ekaṃ gurusutaṃ labhet | manojñaṃ śāstravettāraṃ nigrahānugrahe ratam[taram ka |] || 40 || sundaraṃ yauvanonmattaṃ gurutulyaṃ [na saṃśayaḥ kha-ga |]jitendriyam | prāṇānte'pi ca karttavyaṃ pūjanaṃ mokṣadāyakam || 41 || no yajed yadi mohena saiva [pāpālayā kha-ga |]pāpamayī bhavet || 42 ||
iti śrīmātṛkābhedatantre haragaurīsaṃvāde [pañcadaśaḥ kha-ga |]caturddaśaḥ paṭalaḥ || 14 ||
pṛ0 93) atha śrīmadgurupādukāstotram |
brahmarandhrasarasīruhodare nityalagnamavadātamadbhutam | kuṇḍalīvivarakāṇḍamaṇḍitaṃ dvādaśārṇasarasīruhaṃ bhaje || 1 || tasya kandalitakarṇikāpuṭe kḷptarekhamakathādirekhayā | koṇalakṣitahalakṣamaṇḍalībhāva[lakṣya- prā, ṭa |]lakṣa[-mabalā- prā, ṭa |]mamalālayaṃ bhaje || 2 || tatpuṭe[puṭa- prā |] paṭutaḍitkaḍārimasparddhamānamaṇipāṭalaprabham | cintayāmi hṛdi cinmayaṃ vapu[-rnādabindu- ṭa |]rbindunādamaṇipīṭhamaṇḍalam || 3 || ūrddhvamasya hutabhukśikhāsakhaṃ[-trayaṃ ṭa |] tadvilāsaparibṛṃhaṇāspadam | viśvaghasmara[-mahotsadotkaṭaṃ prā, -mahoccidot- ṭa |]mahotsavotkaṭaṃ vyāmṛṣāmi yugamādihaṃsayoḥ || 4 || tatra nāthacaraṇāravindayoḥ kuṅkamāsava[-parī- ṭa |]jharīmarandayoḥ[-mamandayoḥ ] | dvandvamindukarakandaśītalaṃ mānasaṃ smarati maṅgalāspadam || 5 || niṣaktamaṇipādukāniyamitāghakolāhalaṃ sphuratkiśalayāruṇaṃ nakhasamullasaccandrakam | parāmṛtasarovaroditasarojasadrociṣaṃ bhajāmi śirasi sthitaṃ gurupadāravindadvayam || 6 || pādukāpañcakastotraṃ pañcavaktrād vinirgatam | ṣaḍāmnāyadalopetaṃ[phalaprāptaṃ ṭa phalaṃ- prā |] prapañce cātidurlabham || 7 ||
iti śrīmātṛkābhedatantre sarvatantrottamottame haragaurīsaṃvāde śrīśivavaktrād vinirgataṃ śrīmadgurupādukāstotraṃ samāptam |
